index 0000000000..607977916f
--- /dev/null
+++ b/dev/audit/harnesses/r10_arbiter_off_restore_mutants.py
@@ -0,0 +1,286 @@
+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""R10-ARBITER-OFF-RESTORE's mutation proof: each named mutant of pump_arbiter.py, alone.
+
+Every line this group adds to ``pump_arbiter.py`` that carries behaviour has a
+mutant below; each is applied to a ``git archive`` copy of the tree by
+``tools/audit/seat/mutant_run.py`` (whose NULL run, unmutated, must pass
+first) and the pump-duty arbiter block of ``tests/features.py`` is run
+through ``tools/audit/seat/features_block.py``. Run from the repository root:
+
+    python3 dev/audit/harnesses/r10_arbiter_off_restore_mutants.py
+
+It prints mutant_run's lines, ``SURVIVED NULL`` then ``KILLED <name>`` per
+mutant at the fix head, once for M01-M20 on the arbiter block and once for the
+seam mutants (M21 to M38; M33 retired) on the water-setpoint feedback block, and exits with
+mutant_run's status. A mutant whose ``old`` text no longer occurs exactly once
+is refused before anything runs.
+"""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import json
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import tempfile
+
+BLOCK = (
+    'env PYTHONPATH=tests/hastub python3 tools/audit/seat/features_block.py '
+    '"R.section(\\"pump-duty arbiter — mode and set-points per plan step" "_pa_subs = _PaCoord("'
+)
+MUTANTS = json.loads(r"""
+[
+ {
+  "name": "M01_no_consumer",
+  "file": "custom_components/heatpump_optimizer/pump_arbiter.py",
+  "old": "off_restore.register_consumer(CONSUMER, _restorer, write=write_setpoint_c)",
+  "new": "pass"
+ },
+ {
+  "name": "M02_no_arm",
+  "file": "custom_components/heatpump_optimizer/pump_arbiter.py",
+  "old": "    return slot == \"space_setpoint\" and not await _arm_space(inp, entry, held, entity)",
+  "new": "    return False"
+ },
+ {
+  "name": "M03_no_own_refusal",
+  "file": "custom_components/heatpump_optimizer/pump_arbiter.py",
+  "old": "f\"space_baseline_own:{entity}\", own,",
+  "new": "f\"space_baseline_own:{entity}\", False,"
+ },
+ {
+  "name": "M04_before_ignored",
+  "file": "custom_components/heatpump_optimizer/pump_arbiter.py",
+  "old": "        and _differs(\"space_setpoint\", observed, before)",
+  "new": "        and True"
+ },
+ {
+  "name": "M05_misses_ignored",
+  "file": "custom_components/heatpump_optimizer/pump_arbiter.py",
+  "old": "        and not held.misses.get(\"space_setpoint\") \\\n",
+  "new": "        and True \\\n"
+ },
+ {
+  "name": "M06_power_off_kept",
+  "file": "custom_components/heatpump_optimizer/pump_arbiter.py",
+  "old": "    held.space_before = None if off else held.space_before",
+  "new": "    pass"
+ },
+ {
+  "name": "M07_no_rebaseline",
+  "file": "custom_components/heatpump_optimizer/pump_arbiter.py",
+  "old": "    if await off_restore.async_rebaseline(inp.hass, entry, CONSUMER, entity, baseline):\n",
+  "new": "    if False:\n"
+ },
+ {
+  "name": "M08_release_writes_space",
+  "file": "custom_components/heatpump_optimizer/pump_arbiter.py",
+  "old": "replace(desired(coord, inp, None, dt_util.now()), space_setpoint=None)",
+  "new": "desired(coord, inp, None, dt_util.now())"
+ },
+ {
+  "name": "M09_restored_keeps_record",
+  "file": "custom_components/heatpump_optimizer/pump_arbiter.py",
+  "old": "            record.pop(\"space_setpoint\", None)",
+  "new": "            pass"
+ },
+ {
+  "name": "M10_release_no_persist",
+  "file": "custom_components/heatpump_optimizer/pump_arbiter.py",
+  "old": "    if held.loaded:\n        await _persist(coord)",
+  "new": "    if False:\n        await _persist(coord)"
+ },
+ {
+  "name": "M11_off_no_persist",
+  "file": "custom_components/heatpump_optimizer/pump_arbiter.py",
+  "old": "if held.written or held.retry or held.dropped or held.space_before is not None:",
+  "new": "if held.written or held.retry or held.dropped:"
+ },
+ {
+  "name": "M12_no_grace",
+  "file": "custom_components/heatpump_optimizer/pump_arbiter.py",
+  "old": "        and utc_elapsed_seconds(now, record[1]) >= ECHO_GRACE_S \\\n",
+  "new": "        and True \\\n"
+ },
+ {
+  "name": "M13_forget_keeps_before",
+  "file": "custom_components/heatpump_optimizer/pump_arbiter.py",
+  "old": "held.written, held.misses, held.retry, held.dropped, held.space_before = {}, {}, {}, {}, None",
+  "new": "held.written, held.misses, held.retry, held.dropped = {}, {}, {}, {}"
+ },
+ {
+  "name": "M14_factory_none",
+  "file": "custom_components/heatpump_optimizer/pump_arbiter.py",
+  "old": "    if not entity:\n        return None\n    return off_restore.Restorer(",
+  "new": "    if True:\n        return None\n    return off_restore.Restorer("
+ },
+ {
+  "name": "M15_adopt_skipped",
+  "file": "custom_components/heatpump_optimizer/pump_arbiter.py",
+  "old": "    await _adopt(inp, coord.entry, held, now)\n",
+  "new": "    pass\n"
+ },
+ {
+  "name": "M16_written_differs_ignored",
+  "file": "custom_components/heatpump_optimizer/pump_arbiter.py",
+  "old": "        and _differs(\"space_setpoint\", observed, record[0]) \\\n",
+  "new": "        and True \\\n"
+ },
+ {
+  "name": "M17_adoption_unbounded",
+  "file": "custom_components/heatpump_optimizer/pump_arbiter.py",
+  "old": "    baseline = cast(float, _bounded(inp, \"space_setpoint\", edit))\n",
+  "new": "    baseline = edit\n"
+ },
+ {
+  "name": "M18_send_before_arm",
+  "file": "custom_components/heatpump_optimizer/pump_arbiter.py",
+  "old": "    if await _held_back(inp, coord.entry, held, slot, entity, now):\n        return\n    domain = entity.split(\".\", 1)[0]\n    service = _service(slot, state, value)\n    try:\n        if service is None:\n            await write_setpoint_c(coord.hass, entity, value)\n",
+  "new": "    domain = entity.split(\".\", 1)[0]\n    service = _service(slot, state, value)\n    try:\n        if service is None:\n            await write_setpoint_c(coord.hass, entity, value)\n            if await _held_back(inp, coord.entry, held, slot, entity, now):\n                return\n"
+ },
+ {
+  "name": "M19_grace_strict",
+  "file": "custom_components/heatpump_optimizer/pump_arbiter.py",
+  "old": "utc_elapsed_seconds(now, record[1]) >= ECHO_GRACE_S",
+  "new": "utc_elapsed_seconds(now, record[1]) > ECHO_GRACE_S"
+ },
+ {
+  "name": "M20_restorer_unguarded",
+  "file": "custom_components/heatpump_optimizer/pump_arbiter.py",
+  "old": "    if not entity:\n        return None\n    return off_restore.Restorer(",
+  "new": "    return off_restore.Restorer("
+ }
+]
+""")
+#: The seam with R10-WATER-SETPOINT-FEEDBACK (the merge of #3405): the off
+#: restore's edit adoption reads the space slot before ``hold``, so a loop
+#: write's controller cut is ``_clamp_cut``'s, never a person's baseline; and
+#: the record a loop move drops (``_note_sent``) still refuses the optimizer's
+#: own write as the restore's baseline (roster Carry 8). Their checks sit in
+#: the feedback block, which needs the arbiter block's imports.
+SEAM_BLOCK = (
+    'env PYTHONPATH=tests/hastub python3 tools/audit/seat/features_block.py '
+    '--prelude "from harness import FakeEntry as _pa_entry" '
+    '--prelude "from types import SimpleNamespace as _PaNS" '
+    '--prelude "from heatpump_optimizer.const import MODE_AUTO as _PA_AUTO, MODE_OFF as _PA_OFF" '
+    '"# --- R10-WATER-SETPOINT-FEEDBACK (outside report #3380" "_fb_floor = _fb_sim("'
+)
+SEAM_MUTANTS = json.loads(r"""
+[
+ {
+  "name": "M21_edit_adopts_cut",
+  "file": "custom_components/heatpump_optimizer/pump_arbiter.py",
+  "old": "        and _differs(\"space_setpoint\", observed, before) \\\n        and not _cut_of(held.feedback, record[0], observed)\n",
+  "new": "        and _differs(\"space_setpoint\", observed, before)\n"
+ },
+ {
+  "name": "M22_cut_bracket_open",
+  "file": "custom_components/heatpump_optimizer/pump_arbiter.py",
+  "old": "low - SETPOINT_TOLERANCE <= observed <= high + SETPOINT_TOLERANCE",
+  "new": "low - SETPOINT_TOLERANCE < observed < high + SETPOINT_TOLERANCE"
+ },
+ {
+  "name": "M23_arm_ignores_dropped_record",
+  "file": "custom_components/heatpump_optimizer/pump_arbiter.py",
+  "old": "    last = record[0] if record is not None else held.dropped.get(\"space_setpoint\")\n",
+  "new": "    last = record[0] if record is not None else None\n"
+ },
+ {
+  "name": "M24_prev_not_kept",
+  "file": "custom_components/heatpump_optimizer/pump_arbiter.py",
+  "old": "    if recorded is not None:\n        rec.prev_c = held.dropped[\"space_setpoint\"] = recorded[0]\n",
+  "new": "    rec.prev_c = None\n    if recorded is not None:\n        rec.prev_c = held.dropped[\"space_setpoint\"] = recorded[0]\n"
+ },
+ {
+  "name": "M25_restored_keeps_run",
+  "file": "custom_components/heatpump_optimizer/pump_arbiter.py",
+  "old": "        held.feedback = None  # its prev_c is that record too (_note_sent)\n",
+  "new": "        pass\n"
+ },
+ {
+  "name": "M26_dropped_not_kept",
+  "file": "custom_components/heatpump_optimizer/pump_arbiter.py",
+  "old": "    if recorded is not None:\n        rec.prev_c = held.dropped[\"space_setpoint\"] = recorded[0]\n",
+  "new": "    held.dropped.pop(\"space_setpoint\", None)\n    if recorded is not None:\n        rec.prev_c = held.dropped[\"space_setpoint\"] = recorded[0]\n"
+ },
+ {
+  "name": "M27_off_pass_ends_fact",
+  "file": "custom_components/heatpump_optimizer/pump_arbiter.py",
+  "old": "        held.feedback = None\n        return base\n",
+  "new": "        held.feedback = None\n        held.dropped.clear()\n        return base\n"
+ },
+ {
+  "name": "M28_stale_run_ends_fact",
+  "file": "custom_components/heatpump_optimizer/pump_arbiter.py",
+  "old": "        rec = None  # passes that skipped the loop",
+  "new": "        rec = None; held.dropped.clear()  # passes that skipped the loop"
+ },
+ {
+  "name": "M29_stop_ends_fact",
+  "file": "custom_components/heatpump_optimizer/pump_arbiter.py",
+  "old": "        held.feedback = FeedbackRun(now, base, now)\n        return base\n",
+  "new": "        held.feedback = FeedbackRun(now, base, now)\n        held.dropped.clear()\n        return base\n"
+ },
+ {
+  "name": "M30_new_run_ends_fact",
+  "file": "custom_components/heatpump_optimizer/pump_arbiter.py",
+  "old": "        rec = held.feedback = FeedbackRun(now, base, now)\n",
+  "new": "        rec = held.feedback = FeedbackRun(now, base, now)\n        held.dropped.clear()\n"
+ },
+ {
+  "name": "M31_restart_drops_fact",
+  "file": "custom_components/heatpump_optimizer/pump_arbiter.py",
+  "old": "        \"dropped\": dict(held.dropped),\n",
+  "new": ""
+ },
+ {
+  "name": "M32_load_ignores_fact",
+  "file": "custom_components/heatpump_optimizer/pump_arbiter.py",
+  "old": "    held.dropped = {k: v for k, v in dropped.items() if _writable(k, v)} if isinstance(dropped, dict) else {}\n",
+  "new": "    held.dropped = {}\n"
+ },
+ {
+  "name": "M34_restore_keeps_fact",
+  "file": "custom_components/heatpump_optimizer/pump_arbiter.py",
+  "old": "(held.written, held.misses, held.retry, held.dropped)",
+  "new": "(held.written, held.misses, held.retry)"
+ },
+ {
+  "name": "M35_forget_keeps_dropped",
+  "file": "custom_components/heatpump_optimizer/pump_arbiter.py",
+  "old": "held.written, held.misses, held.retry, held.dropped, held.space_before = {}, {}, {}, {}, None",
+  "new": "held.written, held.misses, held.retry, held.space_before = {}, {}, {}, None"
+ },
+ {
+  "name": "M36_off_ignores_dropped",
+  "file": "custom_components/heatpump_optimizer/pump_arbiter.py",
+  "old": "if held.written or held.retry or held.dropped or held.space_before is not None:",
+  "new": "if held.written or held.retry or held.space_before is not None:"
+ },
+ {
+  "name": "M37_arm_reads_run",
+  "file": "custom_components/heatpump_optimizer/pump_arbiter.py",
+  "old": "    last = record[0] if record is not None else held.dropped.get(\"space_setpoint\")\n",
+  "new": "    last = record[0] if record is not None else None if held.feedback is None else held.feedback.prev_c\n"
+ },
+ {
+  "name": "M38_load_unfiltered",
+  "file": "custom_components/heatpump_optimizer/pump_arbiter.py",
+  "old": " if _writable(k, v)} if isinstance(dropped, dict)",
+  "new": "} if isinstance(dropped, dict)"
+ }
+]
+""")
+
+
+def _run(mutants: list[dict[str, str]], cmd: str) -> int:
+    with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile("w", suffix=".json", delete=False) as spec:
+        json.dump(mutants, spec)
+    return subprocess.call(
+        [sys.executable, "tools/audit/seat/mutant_run.py", "--spec", spec.name, "--cmd", cmd])
+
+
+def main() -> int:
+    return max(_run(MUTANTS, BLOCK), _run(SEAM_MUTANTS, SEAM_BLOCK))
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    sys.exit(main())
diff --git a/dev/audit/harnesses/r10_arch_docs_enumerate.py b/dev/audit/harnesses/r10_arch_docs_enumerate.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000..3b299fa8c9
--- /dev/null
+++ b/dev/audit/harnesses/r10_arch_docs_enumerate.py
@@ -0,0 +1,163 @@
+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""R10-ARCH-DOCS (#2395): the enumerating commands behind the complete-set sentences of the two wiring pages.
+
+    python3 dev/audit/harnesses/r10_arch_docs_enumerate.py
+
+THE RULE. A sentence of docs/architecture.md or dev/README.md that says all, each, every, no, only, or gives a
+count, is a claim about a whole set, and reading one member cannot support it. Each `## N<k>` block below is the
+command that lists the set such a sentence is about, over the whole tree: the modules that name the state machine,
+the jobs and triggers of every workflow file, the beat's jobs, the writers of the hold list, the ledger's kinds,
+the importers and call sites a "one owner" bullet names, every executable reference from one script the
+machinery figure draws to another, and each such script's writes to each store the figure draws. It prints what the tree holds and judges nothing: the pull-request body sets
+each block beside its sentence, and a block that is empty where the sentence needs a member, or holds a member the
+sentence denies, is the finding. Where a block is a zero it carries a control that is not zero.
+
+Prints the blocks in order. Exit is bash's: 0 unless a command of the script could not run.
+"""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import subprocess
+import sys
+
+
+def repo_root(start):
+    """The directory holding custom_components/heatpump_optimizer/manifest.json."""
+    from pathlib import Path
+    here = Path(start).resolve()
+    if here.is_file():
+        here = here.parent
+    marker = Path("custom_components") / "heatpump_optimizer" / "manifest.json"
+    for cand in (here, *here.parents):
+        if (cand / marker).is_file():
+            return cand
+    raise RuntimeError(f"no repository root above {start}")
+
+
+ROOT = repo_root(__file__)
+SCRIPT = r'''
+P=custom_components/heatpump_optimizer; S=tools/audit/seat; W=.github/workflows
+echo "## N1 modules that name the state machine in code (not a comment line)"
+git grep -nE 'hass\.states\b|\bstates\.(get|keys)\(' -- "$P/*.py" | grep -vE '^[^:]+:[0-9]+:\s*#' | cut -d: -f1 | sort | uniq -c
+echo "## N2 ci.yml: events, jobs with needs and uses, prelude outputs"
+python3 - <<'PY'
+import yaml
+d = yaml.safe_load(open('.github/workflows/ci.yml'))
+print('events:', sorted(d[True]))
+for k, v in d['jobs'].items():
+    print(' ', k, '| needs', v.get('needs'), '| uses', v.get('uses'), '| workset-gated', 'workset' in str(v.get('if')))
+print('prelude outputs:', list(d['jobs']['prelude']['outputs']))
+PY
+echo "## N3 every workflow file: its triggers"
+python3 - <<'PY'
+import glob, yaml
+for f in sorted(glob.glob('.github/workflows/*.yml')):
+    on = yaml.safe_load(open(f))[True]
+    on = on if isinstance(on, dict) else {k: None for k in ([on] if isinstance(on, str) else on)}
+    print(' ', f.split('/')[-1], {k: {a: b for a, b in (v if isinstance(v, dict) else {}).items() if a in ('branches', 'tags', 'paths', 'workflows')} for k, v in on.items()})
+PY
+echo "## N4 units ci.yml calls that lack workflow_call, or carry a pull-request trigger (expect none)"
+for u in $(grep -oE 'uses: \./\.github/workflows/[a-z-]+\.yml' $W/ci.yml | sed 's|uses: \./||'); do grep -qE '^  workflow_call:' $u || echo "NO workflow_call $u"; grep -HnE '^  pull_request(_target|_review)?:' $u; done; echo "units called: $(grep -cE 'uses: \./\.github/workflows/' $W/ci.yml)"
+echo "## N5 files with a pull-request trigger"; grep -lE '^  (pull_request|pull_request_target|pull_request_review):' $W/*.yml
+echo "## N6 workflow files not named on dev/README.md (expect none)"; for f in $W/*.yml; do grep -qF "$f" dev/README.md || echo "NOT ON PAGE $f"; done
+echo "## N7 beat jobs: the set of script each job's argv runs, and the job names"
+python3 - <<'PY'
+import json
+d = json.load(open('tools/audit/seat/beatd.jobs.json')); jobs = d['jobs'] if isinstance(d, dict) else d
+print(' ', sorted({j['argv'][2] for j in jobs}), [j['argv'][3] for j in jobs])
+PY
+echo "## N8 beat table and beat_jobs.py: lines naming the relay, the tick, the train, the heartbeat, roster_sync (control: replan.py)"
+for pat in 'cloud_relay|orchestrator_tick|merge_train|heartbeat\.sh' 'roster_sync' 'replan\.py'; do for f in $S/beatd.jobs.json $S/beat_jobs.py; do echo "  $pat in $f: $(grep -cE "$pat" $f)"; done; done
+grep -nE 'cloud_relay|orchestrator_tick|merge_train|heartbeat\.sh' $S/beat_jobs.py | cut -c1-140
+echo "## N9 writes of the hold list under tools/ and .github/ (a redirect into the file)"
+git grep -nE 'cloud-handoff-hold' -- tools .github | grep -E '> *"?\$[A-Za-z/{}"]*cloud-handoff-hold|> "\$\(hold_file\)"' | cut -c1-150
+git grep -nE '>>? *"?\$\(hold_file\)|>>? *"?\$hf\b' -- tools .github | cut -c1-150
+echo "## N10 ledger KINDS by class"
+python3 - <<'PY'
+import re
+src = open('tools/audit/seat/ledger.py').read()
+blk = src[src.index('KINDS = {'):]; blk = blk[:blk.index('}')]
+pairs = re.findall(r'"([a-z-]+)": "(derived|event)"', blk)
+print('  events:', [k for k, c in pairs if c == 'event']); print('  derived:', len([1 for k, c in pairs if c == 'derived']), 'kinds')
+PY
+echo "## N11 production opens of train-stop (control: postmerge-owed)"
+for k in train-stop postmerge-owed; do echo "  $k: $(git grep -nE "\"open\", \"$k\"|ledger_open $k|ledger open $k" -- tools .github | grep -vcE 'self.test|fixture')"; done
+echo "## N12 assignments of the thermal parameters"; git grep -nE '_thermal_params = |_thermal_model\.params = ' -- $P | cut -c1-150
+echo "## N13 learner modules: homeassistant, store and coordinator imports at module level"
+for m in accuracy comfort_learning curve_learning defrost dhw_draws dhw_learning drift snapshots sysid; do echo "  $m: ha=$(grep -cE '^(from|import) +homeassistant' $P/$m.py) store=$(grep -cE '^from +\.store' $P/$m.py) coordinator=$(grep -cE '^from +\.coordinator|^from +\. +import .*\bcoordinator\b' $P/$m.py)"; done
+echo "## N14 heat_energy.py homeassistant imports (control: accuracy.py), and its importers"
+echo "  heat_energy=$(grep -cE 'homeassistant' $P/heat_energy.py | tr -d '\n') lines naming homeassistant, import lines $(grep -cE '^(from|import) +homeassistant' $P/heat_energy.py); accuracy import lines $(grep -cE '^(from|import) +homeassistant' $P/accuracy.py)"; git grep -nE '^(from|import) .*\bheat_energy\b' -- $P
+echo "## N15 calls of model_restart_advice and house_loss_converged"; git grep -nE '(model_restart_advice|house_loss_converged)\(' -- $P | grep -v ':def ' | cut -c1-130
+echo "## N16 config_flow.py: every form shown, and whether its schema is the registry's"
+grep -nE 'async_show_form\(' $P/config_flow.py | while IFS=: read n rest; do echo "  $n $(sed -n "$((n)),$((n+6))p" $P/config_flow.py | grep -oE 'data_schema=[A-Za-z_.]+\(?' | head -1)"; done; grep -nE '^class .*Flow' $P/config_flow.py | cut -c1-120
+echo "## N17 dependency-graph.yml path filters"; python3 -c "import yaml;print(' ',yaml.safe_load(open('.github/workflows/dependency-graph.yml'))[True]['push']['paths'])"
+echo "## N18 executable references from one drawn script to another (a literal path, a path under a variable, an import or a module call; comment lines dropped)"
+A="cloud_dispatch.py tick_loop.sh cloud_relay.sh bus.sh orchestrator_tick.py beat_jobs.py state_docs.py plan_page.py roster_queue.py roster_edit.py open_pr.sh merge_train.py postmerge.py roster_sync.py heartbeat.sh"
+for a in $A; do for b in $A replan.py open_driver.py carry_fold.py; do [ "$a" = "$b" ] && continue; s=${b%.*}
+  n=$(grep -nE "(^\s*import +$s\b|^\s*from +$s +import|/ *\"$s\.(py|sh)\"|HERE/$s\.(py|sh)|seat/$s\.(py|sh)|plan/$s\.py|\\$\\{?[A-Za-z_]+\\}?/$s\.(py|sh)|\{[a-z_]+\}/$s\.(py|sh)|tool\(\"$s\"\)|\b$s\.[a-z_]+\()" $S/$a | grep -vE '^[0-9]+:\s*#' | cut -d: -f1 | tr '\n' ' ')
+  [ -n "$n" ] && echo "  $a -> $b: lines $n"; done; done
+echo "## N19 the figure's arrows and the table's rows"
+echo "  arrows $(grep -cE '^    \w+ -->\|"(runs|writes)"\| \w+$' dev/README.md) rows $(grep -cE '^\| [^|]+ \| (runs|writes) \| ' dev/README.md)"
+echo "## N20 writes from each drawn script to each drawn store, outside self-tests and docstrings: DRAWN when the figure has that arrow"
+python3 - <<'PY'
+import ast, re
+from pathlib import Path
+page = Path('dev/README.md').read_text()
+fig = page[page.index('flowchart TB'):]; fig = fig[:fig.index('```')]
+label = dict(re.findall(r'^ {8}(\w+)[\[\(]+"([^"<]+)', fig, re.M))
+arrows = set(re.findall(r'^    (\w+) -->\|"(runs|writes)"\| (\w+)$', fig, re.M))
+files = {}
+for nid, text in label.items():
+    if re.fullmatch(r'[a-z_]+\.(py|sh)', text.split()[0]) and Path('tools/audit/seat', text.split()[0]).is_file():
+        files.setdefault(text.split()[0], set()).add(nid)
+PUSH = r'(\bpush\b|"push")'
+STORES = {
+    'dref': PUSH + r'.*refs/heads/(\{ref\}|dispatch/)',
+    'drec': r'>>? *"?\$S/dispatched',
+    'bus': r'^\s*append_commit |' + PUSH + r'.*refs/heads/(review|verdict|design|probe|handoff)',
+    'ledger': r'ledger\.py"?,? +"?(open|close|attempt)\b|\bledger_(open|close)\b|"(open|close|attempt)", "[a-z][a-z-]+"',
+    'pr': r'"gh", "pr", "(create|edit|comment|close|ready)"|\bgh pr (create|edit|comment|close|ready)\b|update_pr\.sh|tool\("app_push"\)|"\$_push"|\$POSTER',
+    'main': r'"--merge"|\bpr merge\b',
+    'thold': r'git/refs/heads/train-hold',
+    'hbref': PUSH + r'.*refs/heads/\$REF|"\$c:refs/heads/\$REF"',
+    'board': r'mv -f "\$tmp" "\$out"',
+    'roster': PUSH + r'.*refs/heads/\{branch\}|refspec = f"\{head\}:refs/heads/\{branch\}"',
+    'sdoc': r'refs/heads/\{state_ref\}',
+    'hold': r'>>? *"?\$(\(hold_file\)|hf\b)',
+}
+TESTY = re.compile(r'self_?test|_checks$|^_?test|fixture|world')
+def skipped(path, text):
+    """Line numbers inside a self-test function or a docstring."""
+    out = set()
+    if path.suffix == '.py':
+        tree = ast.parse(text)
+        for d in ast.walk(tree):
+            if isinstance(d, (ast.FunctionDef, ast.AsyncFunctionDef, ast.ClassDef, ast.Module)):
+                if not isinstance(d, ast.Module) and TESTY.search(d.name):
+                    out.update(range(d.lineno, d.end_lineno + 1))
+                body = d.body
+                if body and isinstance(body[0], ast.Expr) and isinstance(getattr(body[0], 'value', None), ast.Constant) \
+                        and isinstance(body[0].value.value, str):
+                    out.update(range(body[0].lineno, body[0].end_lineno + 1))
+    else:
+        start = None
+        for i, l in enumerate(text.splitlines(), 1):
+            m = re.match(r'^([a-z_]+)\(\) *\{?\s*$', l)
+            if m and TESTY.search(m.group(1)):
+                start = i
+            if start and l.startswith('}'):
+                out.update(range(start, i + 1)); start = None
+    return out
+for fname, nids in sorted(files.items()):
+    path = Path('tools/audit/seat', fname); text = path.read_text(); skip = skipped(path, text)
+    lines = text.splitlines()
+    for st, pat in STORES.items():
+        hits = [i for i, l in enumerate(lines, 1) if i not in skip and not l.lstrip().startswith('#') and re.search(pat, l)]
+        if hits:
+            state = 'DRAWN' if any((n, 'writes', st) in arrows for n in nids) else 'UNDRAWN'
+            print(f'  {state} {fname} -> {label[st].strip()}: lines {" ".join(map(str, hits))}')
+PY
+'''
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    sys.exit(subprocess.run(["bash", "-s"], input=SCRIPT, text=True, cwd=ROOT).returncode)
diff --git a/dev/audit/harnesses/r10_arch_docs_evidence.py b/dev/audit/harnesses/r10_arch_docs_evidence.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000..a4088ff52a
--- /dev/null
+++ b/dev/audit/harnesses/r10_arch_docs_evidence.py
@@ -0,0 +1,64 @@
+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""R10-ARCH-DOCS (#2395): every evidence row of a pull-request body holds the text it quotes at the line it cites.
+
+    python3 dev/audit/harnesses/r10_arch_docs_evidence.py BODY.md
+
+THE RULE. An evidence row is a body line of the form `  - ` + backticked `path:line` + a space + the backticked
+text. The row holds when that text is a substring of that line of that file in this checkout. A row whose text is
+elsewhere in the file is still a miss, printed with the lines that do hold it: a moved citation is corrected in the
+body, never matched loosely here. The check says nothing about whether the quoted line supports the sentence it is
+filed under; that is the reader's judgement, and this only keeps the citation from drifting off its line.
+
+Prints one `MISS` line per row that does not hold, then `RESULT rows=`, `RESULT hold=` and `RESULT miss=`. Exit 1 on
+a miss or on a body with no row, 2 on a usage error.
+"""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import re
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+
+
+def repo_root(start):
+    """The directory holding custom_components/heatpump_optimizer/manifest.json."""
+    from pathlib import Path
+    here = Path(start).resolve()
+    if here.is_file():
+        here = here.parent
+    marker = Path("custom_components") / "heatpump_optimizer" / "manifest.json"
+    for cand in (here, *here.parents):
+        if (cand / marker).is_file():
+            return cand
+    raise RuntimeError(f"no repository root above {start}")
+
+
+ROOT = repo_root(__file__)
+ROW = re.compile(r"^  - `([^`:\n]+):(\d+)` (?:`` ?(.+?) ?``|`([^`\n]+)`)$", re.M)
+
+
+def misses(body: str, root: Path) -> tuple[int, list[str]]:
+    rows = ROW.findall(body)
+    out = []
+    for path, line, wide, plain in rows:
+        text, f = wide or plain, root / path
+        lines = f.read_text().splitlines() if f.is_file() else []
+        if int(line) > len(lines) or text not in lines[int(line) - 1]:
+            near = [i + 1 for i, got in enumerate(lines) if text in got][:4]
+            out.append(f"MISS {path}:{line} {text!r} (the text is at {near or 'no line'})")
+    return len(rows), out
+
+
+def main(argv: list[str]) -> int:
+    if len(argv) != 2:
+        print(__doc__.split("\n\n")[1].strip(), file=sys.stderr)
+        return 2
+    n, out = misses(Path(argv[1]).read_text(), ROOT)
+    print("\n".join(out), end="\n" if out else "")
+    print(f"RESULT rows={n}")
+    print(f"RESULT hold={n - len(out)}")
+    print(f"RESULT miss={len(out)}")
+    return 1 if out or not n else 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    sys.exit(main(sys.argv))
diff --git a/dev/audit/harnesses/r10_arch_docs_mutants.py b/dev/audit/harnesses/r10_arch_docs_mutants.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000..bdcc37be52
--- /dev/null
+++ b/dev/audit/harnesses/r10_arch_docs_mutants.py
@@ -0,0 +1,128 @@
+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""R10-ARCH-DOCS (#2395): each predicate line of the machinery-edge and due-marker checks, mutated, against doc_claims.
+
+    PYTHONPATH=tests/hastub python3 dev/audit/harnesses/r10_arch_docs_mutants.py
+
+THE RULE. MUTANTS below is one row per predicate of `machinery_edge_findings` and `due_marker_findings` in
+tests/doc_claims.py: the exact source text of the test, and what replaces it so the predicate can never fire. A row
+whose text is not in the file exactly once is an error, not a skip, so a predicate renamed away from its mutant is
+seen. The mutated source is executed in a child with `__file__` set to the real path; nothing is written to the tree.
+A mutant is killed when the child prints a FAIL line or dies. The baseline, unmutated, must print none.
+
+LIVE below is the two calls those checks make on the pages themselves. Dropping one cannot fail on a clean page, so
+each is shown three ways instead: alone it reads as the baseline; with a defect planted in the text the check reads
+the kept call fails by name; with the plant and the dropped call that name is gone.
+
+Prints one line per mutant with the checks that failed, one per live call, then `RESULT baseline_fails=`,
+`RESULT mutants=`, `RESULT killed=`, `RESULT live_calls=` and `RESULT live_calls_shown=`. Exit 1 unless the
+baseline is clean, every mutant is killed and every live call is shown.
+"""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import subprocess
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+
+
+
+def repo_root(start):
+    """The directory holding custom_components/heatpump_optimizer/manifest.json."""
+    from pathlib import Path
+    here = Path(start).resolve()
+    if here.is_file():
+        here = here.parent
+    marker = Path("custom_components") / "heatpump_optimizer" / "manifest.json"
+    for cand in (here, *here.parents):
+        if (cand / marker).is_file():
+            return cand
+    raise RuntimeError(f"no repository root above {start}")
+
+
+ROOT = repo_root(__file__)
+TARGET = ROOT / "tests" / "doc_claims.py"
+MUTANTS = (
+    ("due marker", 'for r in rows if r["due"] and r["scope"] == "wiring"]', 'for r in rows if False]'),
+    ("verb", "if verb not in MACHINERY_VERBS:", "if False:"),
+    ("store as actor", 'if nodes[a][1] == "store":', "if False:"),
+    ("writes ends at a store", 'elif (verb == "writes") != (nodes[b][1] == "store"):', "elif False:"),
+    ("arrow with no row", "sorted(drawn - cited)]", "()]"),
+    ("row with no arrow", "sorted(cited - drawn)]", "()]"),
+    ("quoted text in the cited file", "elif quote not in src:", "elif False:"),
+    ("cited file tracked", 'if src is None:\n            out.append(f"{a} -{v}-> {b}: cites', 'if False:\n            out.append(f"{a} -{v}-> {b}: cites'),
+    ("cited file is the actor's", '!= a.split()[0]:', '!= a.split()[0] and False:'),
+    ("one script per node", 'if k == "script" and len(_FILE.findall(n)) != 1]', 'if False]'),
+    ("a script node names a script (reviewer's N1)", "len(_FILE.findall(n)) != 1]", "len(_FILE.findall(n)) > 1]"),
+    ("a script node names no second script", "len(_FILE.findall(n)) != 1]", "len(_FILE.findall(n)) < 1]"),
+    ("the cited file is the node's first word, not a part of it (reviewer's N4)", "!= a.split()[0]:", "not in a:"),
+    ("a store is no entry (reviewer's P3)", 'if nodes[i][1] != "store" and all(b != n', "if all(b != n"),
+    ("the entry is a seat", ' or kind[entries[0]][0] != "seat":', ' or False:'),
+    ("one entry", 'if len(entries) != 1 or kind[entries[0]][0] != "seat":', "if False:"),
+    ("one arrow per line", "if not m or m.group(1) not in nodes or m.group(3) not in nodes:", "if False:"),
+    ("node names unique", "if list(name.values()).count(n) > 1})]", "if False})]"),
+)
+# The two live calls (reviewer's P7, P8). A mutant that drops the call a check makes on the page itself cannot be
+# told from the baseline while the page is clean: both read no finding. So each is run three ways. Alone, it must
+# read exactly as the baseline does. With a defect planted in what the check reads (in the child's source, never in
+# the tree), the unmutated check must fail by name. With the plant and the mutant together that name must be gone:
+# the dropped call is the one that fires.
+LIVE = (
+    ("the due-marker call on the pages (reviewer's P7)",
+     "    due = due_marker_findings(rows)\n", "    due = []\n",
+     "    docs = marker_docs()\n    stages = roster_stages()\n    rows = marker_census(docs, stages or {})\n",
+     "    docs = marker_docs()\n    stages = roster_stages()\n"
+     "    docs = {**docs, MACHINERY_DOC: docs[MACHINERY_DOC] + '\\n- planted [target: '"
+     " + sorted(g for g, st in (stages or {}).items() if st == 'done')[0] + ']\\n'}\n"
+     "    rows = marker_census(docs, stages or {})\n",
+     "no wiring marker names only done groups: each is resolved into a statement of the tree (#2395)"),
+    ("the machinery call on the page (reviewer's P8)",
+     "    errs = machinery_edge_findings(text, _read_tracked(tree))\n", "    errs = []\n",
+     "    text = (ROOT / MACHINERY_DOC).read_text()\n",
+     "    text = (ROOT / MACHINERY_DOC).read_text()\n    _planted = '    tloop -->|\"runs\"| relay\\n'\n"
+     "    assert text.count(_planted) == 1\n"
+     "    text = text.replace(_planted, '    relay -->|\"runs\"| tloop\\n')\n",
+     "every arrow is cited, every citation holds in the tree, and the figure has one entry"),
+)
+RUNNER = ("import sys; sys.argv = [sys.argv[1]]; sys.path.insert(0, sys.argv[0].rsplit('/', 1)[0]); "
+          "exec(compile(sys.stdin.read(), sys.argv[0], 'exec'), {'__name__': '__main__', '__file__': sys.argv[0]})")
+
+
+def fails(src: str) -> list[str]:
+    r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-c", RUNNER, str(TARGET)], input=src, capture_output=True, text=True, cwd=ROOT)
+    out = [line.strip()[5:].split("  [")[0] for line in r.stdout.splitlines() if line.strip().startswith("FAIL ")]
+    return out or ([f"died rc={r.returncode}: {r.stderr.strip().splitlines()[-1][:120]}"] if r.returncode else [])
+
+
+def main() -> int:
+    src = TARGET.read_text()
+    base = fails(src)
+    print(f"baseline: {len(base)} FAIL line(s)")
+    killed = 0
+    for what, old, new in MUTANTS:
+        if src.count(old) != 1:
+            print(f"ERROR {what}: {old!r} is in the file {src.count(old)} time(s), not once")
+            return 2
+        got = fails(src.replace(old, new))
+        killed += bool(got)
+        print(f"{'killed  ' if got else 'SURVIVED'} {what}: {'; '.join(got) or '-'}")
+    shown = 0
+    for what, old, new, plant_old, plant_new, name in LIVE:
+        if src.count(old) != 1 or src.count(plant_old) != 1:
+            print(f"ERROR {what}: anchors in the file {src.count(old)} and {src.count(plant_old)} time(s), not once each")
+            return 2
+        alone = fails(src.replace(old, new))
+        planted = fails(src.replace(plant_old, plant_new))
+        both = fails(src.replace(plant_old, plant_new).replace(old, new))
+        ok = alone == base and name in planted and name not in both
+        shown += ok
+        print(f"{'shown   ' if ok else 'NOT SHOWN'} {what}: alone {len(alone)} FAIL line(s); planted defect, call kept: "
+              f"{'; '.join(planted) or '-'}; planted defect, call dropped: {'; '.join(both) or '-'}")
+    print(f"RESULT baseline_fails={len(base)}")
+    print(f"RESULT mutants={len(MUTANTS)}")
+    print(f"RESULT killed={killed}")
+    print(f"RESULT live_calls={len(LIVE)}")
+    print(f"RESULT live_calls_shown={shown}")
+    return 0 if not base and killed == len(MUTANTS) and shown == len(LIVE) else 1
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    sys.exit(main())
diff --git a/dev/audit/harnesses/r10_card_blocker_names.py b/dev/audit/harnesses/r10_card_blocker_names.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000..ef27d872ba
--- /dev/null
+++ b/dev/audit/harnesses/r10_card_blocker_names.py
@@ -0,0 +1,92 @@
+"""R10-HOTFIX-CARD-HEALTH-TEXT: which of the card's class and id names a
+content blocker's generic element-hiding rules target, per filter list.
+
+    python3 -I dev/audit/harnesses/r10_card_blocker_names.py [<git ref>]
+
+Fetches the lists at run time (nothing is vendored: EasyList is GPLv3 /
+CC BY-SA), keeps each generic `##<selector>` rule (no domain), and reports
+every card name a rule targets by a plain `.name` / `#name` token or a
+`[class|id <op>= "v"]` attribute test (=, ~=, ^=, $=, *=, |=). The card's
+names are tests/card_rig.mjs's cardNames, the reader tests/card.mjs's
+barrier uses, kept to the class and id values that reach the DOM (not the
+stylesheet's selector tokens). Run from the repository root. A rule's
+plain tokens are read outside its brackets and parentheses; a compound
+rule with further conditions is reported whole, for the reader to judge.
+Exit 0 always; the lane barrier is tests/card.mjs, not this. The null
+control is the base ref: at v7.1.11 it reads `adv-text` and
+`adv-label` from EasyList and AdGuard Base.
+"""
+
+import json
+import re
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import urllib.request
+
+CARD = "custom_components/heatpump_optimizer/www/heatpump-optimizer-card.js"
+LISTS = {
+    "EasyList general hide": "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/easylist/easylist/master/easylist/easylist_general_hide.txt",
+    "AdGuard Base (chromium)": "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AdguardTeam/FiltersRegistry/master/platforms/extension/chromium/filters/2.txt",
+    "AdGuard Base (uBlock flavour)": "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AdguardTeam/FiltersRegistry/master/platforms/extension/ublock/filters/2.txt",
+    "uBlock filters": "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/uBlockOrigin/uAssets/master/filters/filters.txt",
+}
+ATTR = re.compile(r"""\[\s*(class|id)\s*([~^$*|]?)=\s*["']?([^"'\]\s]+)["']?\s*(?:i\s*)?\]""")
+
+
+def card_names(src):
+    """(kind, name) for every class and id the card writes into its DOM,
+    read by tests/card_rig.mjs's cardNames (the one reader)."""
+    js = ("import { cardNames } from './tests/card_rig.mjs';"
+          "let s = ''; process.stdin.on('data', (d) => { s += d; });"
+          "process.stdin.on('end', () => console.log(JSON.stringify(cardNames(s))));")
+    out = subprocess.run(["node", "--input-type=module", "-e", js], input=src,
+                         check=True, capture_output=True, text=True).stdout
+    return {(k, n) for k, n in json.loads(out) if k in ("class", "id")}
+
+
+def index(rules):
+    """Plain `.name` / `#name` tokens, and the class / id attribute tests."""
+    plain, attrs = {}, []
+    for r in rules:
+        bare = re.sub(r"\[[^\]]*\]|\([^)]*\)", " ", r)
+        for sig, tok in re.findall(r"([.#])(-?[A-Za-z_][\w-]*)", bare):
+            plain.setdefault(("class" if sig == "." else "id", tok), []).append(r)
+        attrs.extend((kind, op, v, r) for kind, op, v in ATTR.findall(r))
+    return plain, attrs
+
+
+def targeted(kind, name, plain, attrs):
+    hit = list(plain.get((kind, name), []))
+    for k, op, v, r in attrs:
+        if k != kind:
+            continue
+        if (op in ("", "~") and name == v) or (op == "^" and name.startswith(v)) or \
+           (op == "$" and name.endswith(v)) or (op == "*" and v in name) or \
+           (op == "|" and (name == v or name.startswith(v + "-"))):
+            hit.append(r)
+    return hit
+
+
+def main():
+    ref = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "HEAD"
+    src = subprocess.run(["git", "show", f"{ref}:{CARD}"], check=True,
+                         capture_output=True, text=True).stdout
+    names = sorted(card_names(src))
+    print(f"card at {ref}: {len(names)} names")
+    for label, url in LISTS.items():
+        text = urllib.request.urlopen(url, timeout=120).read().decode("utf-8", "replace")
+        stamp = next((ln for ln in text.splitlines()[:40]
+                      if re.match(r"! (TimeUpdated|Last modified|Version):", ln)), "! (no stamp)")
+        rules = [ln[2:] for ln in text.splitlines() if ln.startswith("##")]
+        plain, attrs = index(rules)
+        hits = {f"{k} {n}": h for k, n in names if (h := targeted(k, n, plain, attrs))}
+        print(f"{label}: {len(rules)} generic rules; {stamp[2:]}; {url}")
+        for n, r in sorted(hits.items()):
+            print(f"  {n}: {', '.join(r[:4])}{' ...' if len(r) > 4 else ''}")
+        alone = sorted(k for k, h in hits.items()
+                       if any(r.strip() == ("." if k.startswith("class") else "#") + k.split(" ", 1)[1] for r in h))
+        print(f"  targeted by a rule naming it alone ({len(alone)}): {', '.join(alone) or 'none'}")
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
