diff --git a/dev/audit/harnesses/r10_dhw_charge_settle_p90.py b/dev/audit/harnesses/r10_dhw_charge_settle_p90.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000..7b2de55267
--- /dev/null
+++ b/dev/audit/harnesses/r10_dhw_charge_settle_p90.py
@@ -0,0 +1,159 @@
+"""R10-OUTSIDE-DHW-CHARGE-SETTLE: the heavy-day p90 a charge-start dip adds.
+
+Drives one ``DhwProfileLearner`` per arm through 28 simulated days, the
+tank integrated per minute and the learner sampled at each of
+``CADENCES_MIN`` (the production refresh range and a 5-min null control),
+and prints, per draw window, the folded occurrence
+count and ``DrawStats.quantile(label, 0.9)`` -- the heavy-day statistic the
+planner reads -- plus the usage-profile points learned. Arms:
+
+  dip       a daily morning draw, then a 10-minute DHW charge whose start
+            drops the reading 4 K, the dip peaking after the charge ends
+  truth     the same trace with the dip removed: what the learner should see
+  flat      the same draws and the same reheat, the DHW heating flag never
+            set and no dip -- what a compressor start for space heating is
+            to the learner, whose only heating input is the plan's DHW
+            flag: the flat control, which the fix must leave bit-identical
+  dip@max   ``dip`` and ``truth`` with the cooling rate pinned at
+  truth@max DHW_COOLING_RATE_MAX, the clamp end of the learner's input
+            range (every arm starts from a fresh learner: zero evidence)
+
+Run from the tree under test, at both ends:
+
+  PYTHONPATH=tests/hastub:custom_components python3 \
+    dev/audit/harnesses/r10_dhw_charge_settle_p90.py [cadence_min ...]
+
+Exit 0 always; it measures, the caller compares.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import asyncio
+import types
+from datetime import datetime, timedelta
+
+import numpy as np
+
+from heatpump_optimizer import dhw_learning as dl
+from heatpump_optimizer.const import DHW_COOLING_RATE_MAX
+from heatpump_optimizer.dhw_draws import labels_for
+from heatpump_optimizer.thermal_model import TANK_ROOM_AMBIENT_TEMP, ThermalParameters
+
+STEP_MIN = 5
+DAYS = 28
+SEED = 3434
+DIP_K = 4.0  # charge-start transient depth, the author's 3-5 K
+DIP_PEAK_MIN = 15.0  # the dip bottoms 5 min after the 10-minute charge ends
+SETPOINT_C = 55.0
+CHARGE_START_MIN = 7 * 60 + 30  # every day's charge starts at 07:30
+#: The learner's production cadence is the coordinator refresh,
+#: ``optimization_interval``: 30 min by default, 10-120 min in 5-min steps.
+#: 5 min is below every configurable interval: a sub-cadence null control.
+CADENCES_MIN = (5, 10, 15, 30, 60)
+
+
+def dip_at(minutes_since_start: float) -> float:
+    """The reading's offset below the true tank temperature after a charge start."""
+    if minutes_since_start < 0:
+        return 0.0
+    if minutes_since_start <= DIP_PEAK_MIN:
+        return DIP_K * minutes_since_start / DIP_PEAK_MIN
+    return max(0.0, DIP_K * (1.0 - (minutes_since_start - DIP_PEAK_MIN) / 20.0))
+
+
+def run(
+    arm: str, rate: float | None = None, draw_min: int = 7 * 60, charge_min: int = 10,
+    step_min: int = STEP_MIN,
+) -> dict:
+    """One arm; the tank is integrated per minute, the learner sampled every ``step_min``.
+
+    The physics is the same at every cadence, so arms at two cadences differ
+    only in what the learner sees. The plan's DHW flag is read at each sample,
+    as ``dhw_heating_active`` is (the plan's scheduled power, not a device state).
+    """
+    params = ThermalParameters()
+    params.dhw_enabled = True
+    cap = params.dhw_store.capacity_kwh_per_c
+    clock = [datetime(2026, 11, 2, 0, 0)]
+    heating = [False]
+    usage_points = [0]
+
+    learner = dl.DhwProfileLearner(
+        None, "h", lambda: params,
+        publish=lambda **k: usage_points.__setitem__(0, usage_points[0] + 1),
+        frozen=lambda *a: None,
+        heating_active=lambda: heating[0],
+        external_heat_active=lambda: False,
+    )
+
+    async def _noop() -> None:
+        return None
+
+    learner.async_save_draws = _noop
+    learner.async_save_profile = _noop
+    true_rate = 0.3
+    learner.cooling_rate = rate if rate is not None else true_rate
+    dl.dt_util = types.SimpleNamespace(now=lambda: clock[0])
+
+    rng = np.random.default_rng(SEED)
+    draws_kwh = rng.lognormal(mean=1.0, sigma=0.5, size=DAYS)
+    t_true = SETPOINT_C
+    flagged = arm != "flat"  # flat: an unflagged reheat, no dip
+    heat_per_min = 1.0 - 0.5 ** (1.0 / 5.0)  # halves the gap to the setpoint in 5 min
+    loop = asyncio.new_event_loop()
+    for i in range(DAYS * 24 * 60):
+        day, minute = divmod(i, 24 * 60)
+        t_true -= true_rate * (t_true - TANK_ROOM_AMBIENT_TEMP) / 25.0 / 60.0
+        if draw_min <= minute < draw_min + 15:  # the morning draw, over 15 min
+            t_true -= draws_kwh[day] / 15.0 / cap
+        since_charge = minute - CHARGE_START_MIN
+        if 0 <= since_charge < charge_min:
+            t_true += (SETPOINT_C - t_true) * heat_per_min
+        if i % step_min:
+            continue
+        now = clock[0] = datetime(2026, 11, 2) + timedelta(minutes=i)
+        heating[0] = flagged and 0 <= since_charge < charge_min
+        reading = t_true
+        if arm.startswith("dip"):
+            reading -= dip_at(since_charge)
+        loop.run_until_complete(learner.async_learn_dynamics(round(reading, 2)))
+    loop.close()
+    stats = learner.draw_stats
+    out = {
+        "usage_points": usage_points[0],
+        "profile_h7": round(learner.hourly_profile[7], 4),
+        "cooling_rate": round(learner.cooling_rate, 4),
+    }
+    for label in labels_for(params.dhw_demand_windows):
+        q = stats.quantile(label, 0.9)
+        out[label] = (stats.count(label), None if q is None else round(q, 4))
+    return out
+
+
+#: (geometry name, draw start minute of the day, charge length in minutes);
+#: the charge always starts at 07:30.
+GEOMETRIES = (
+    ("draw-0700", 7 * 60, 10),  # the draw ends before the charge
+    ("draw-0720", 7 * 60 + 20, 10),  # the draw starts 10 min before the charge
+    ("draw-0735", 7 * 60 + 35, 10),  # the draw starts during the charge
+    ("draw-0745", 7 * 60 + 45, 10),  # 5 min after the last heated sample
+    ("draw-0800", 8 * 60, 10),  # past the settle window (control)
+    ("long-0700", 7 * 60, 40),  # a 40-min charge: the dip recovers while heated
+    ("long-0745", 7 * 60 + 45, 40),  # a draw during the long charge
+)
+
+
+ARMS = (
+    ("dip", None), ("truth", None), ("flat", None),
+    ("dip@max", DHW_COOLING_RATE_MAX), ("truth@max", DHW_COOLING_RATE_MAX),
+)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    import sys
+
+    steps = [int(a) for a in sys.argv[1:]] or list(CADENCES_MIN)
+    for step in steps:
+        for geo, draw_min, charge_min in GEOMETRIES:
+            for arm, rate in ARMS:
+                print(f"{step:3d}min {geo} {arm:9s} {run(arm, rate, draw_min, charge_min, step)}")
diff --git a/dev/audit/harnesses/r10_dhw_start_hysteresis.py b/dev/audit/harnesses/r10_dhw_start_hysteresis.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000..ad2de645ee
--- /dev/null
+++ b/dev/audit/harnesses/r10_dhw_start_hysteresis.py
@@ -0,0 +1,167 @@
+"""R10-OUTSIDE-DHW-START-HYSTERESIS: planned hot-water runs the pump would not start.
+
+Drives the optimizer as ``tests/validate.py`` drives it, over 18 solves (price
+profiles winter_typical and flat; weather winter_cold, winter_mild and
+summer_warm; starting tank 45, 50 and 53 degC; everyday set-point 55; 24 h at
+15 minutes), and counts the planned hot-water runs that do not begin at step 0
+against a start temperature of the set-point less each of 2, 4 and 6 K.
+
+    PYTHONPATH=tests/hastub python3 dev/audit/harnesses/r10_dhw_start_hysteresis.py [TREE] [--hysteresis K]
+        [--setpoint C] [--step S]
+
+TREE is a checkout root (default: this one; a ``git archive`` export of the
+merge base reads the gap). ``--hysteresis K`` hands the planner the pump's
+start hysteresis (``ThermalState.dhw_start_hysteresis_k``); a tree without the
+field prints ``hysteresis=unsupported`` and plans as it always did.
+``--setpoint C`` is the everyday set-point (default 55). ``--step S`` is the
+step of the set-point entity the target is written to: the written target is
+then the set-point rounded down onto it (the charge limit is the set-point),
+every count below is against that written target less K, and the planner is
+handed the entity's grid (``ThermalState.dhw_setpoint_grid``); a tree without
+that field prints ``step=<S> unsupported`` and judges against the set-point
+as it stands, which is the gap a stepped entity opens (58 on a 5 degC step:
+written 55, judged against 58).
+
+RESULT lines, each a sum over the 18 solves:
+  runs_not_at_step0                      planned runs beginning after step 0
+  runs_at_or_above_minus_{2,4,6}k        of those, begun on a tank at or above the written target - K
+  kwh_planned / kwh_at_or_above_minus_4k planned hot-water kWh, and the share in those runs
+  write_to_start_max_c                   the highest set-point that would start one of the
+                                         minus-4 K runs with a 4 K hysteresis (tank + 4);
+                                         above 55 it is over the user's charge limit
+  floor_deficit_k_steps                  degree-steps of the simulated tank under 45 degC
+  dhw_cost                               the planned hot-water energy at the day's prices
+  plan_sha1                              sha1 over the 18 hot-water schedules and trajectories
+  repair_rounds_max / placements         the most floor-repair calls one placement under a start
+                                         condition made (``dhw_planner.place_startable``), and
+                                         how many placements were counted; "none" with no condition
+Null control: ``--hysteresis`` unset and ``--hysteresis 0`` print the
+plan_sha1 the merge base prints; a hysteresis of 4 prints
+runs_at_or_above_minus_4k=0 only on a tree whose planner reads it.
+"""
+import hashlib
+import math
+import os
+import sys
+from datetime import datetime
+
+import numpy as np
+
+ARGS = sys.argv[1:]
+HYSTERESIS = None
+if "--hysteresis" in ARGS:
+    at = ARGS.index("--hysteresis")
+    HYSTERESIS = float(ARGS[at + 1])
+    del ARGS[at : at + 2]
+OPTS = {"--setpoint": 55.0, "--step": None}
+for flag in OPTS:
+    if flag in ARGS:
+        at = ARGS.index(flag)
+        OPTS[flag] = float(ARGS[at + 1])
+        del ARGS[at : at + 2]
+TREE = os.path.abspath(ARGS[0] if ARGS else os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "..", "..", ".."))
+sys.path[:0] = [os.path.join(TREE, "tests"), os.path.join(TREE, "custom_components")]
+
+from profiles import house, prices, solve_inputs, weather  # noqa: E402
+from heatpump_optimizer.optimizer import HeatPumpOptimizer, OptimizationConfig  # noqa: E402
+from heatpump_optimizer.thermal_model import ThermalModel, ThermalParameters, ThermalState  # noqa: E402
+
+from heatpump_optimizer import dhw_planner  # noqa: E402
+
+START = datetime(2026, 1, 15, 0, 0)
+ROUNDS: list[int] = []
+if hasattr(dhw_planner, "place_startable"):
+    _place = dhw_planner.place_startable
+
+    def _counted(plan, start_below, temps_of, repair):
+        calls = [0]
+
+        def counting(**kwargs):
+            calls[0] += 1
+            return repair(**kwargs)
+
+        out = _place(plan, start_below, temps_of, counting)
+        if start_below is not None:
+            ROUNDS.append(calls[0])
+        return out
+
+    dhw_planner.place_startable = _counted
+STEP_C = OPTS["--step"]
+SETPOINT_C, FLOOR_C, DT_H = OPTS["--setpoint"], 45.0, 0.25
+#: The target the pump is handed: the set-point, rounded down onto the entity's step.
+WRITTEN_C = SETPOINT_C if STEP_C is None else math.floor(SETPOINT_C / STEP_C + 1e-9) * STEP_C
+SUPPORTED = hasattr(ThermalState(), "dhw_start_hysteresis_k")
+STEP_SUPPORTED = hasattr(ThermalState(), "dhw_setpoint_grid")
+
+
+def solve(price_p: str, weather_p: str, tank_c: float):
+    cfg = house()
+    params = ThermalParameters.from_config(cfg)
+    params.dhw_enabled = True
+    params.dhw_setpoint = SETPOINT_C
+    opt = HeatPumpOptimizer(ThermalModel(params), OptimizationConfig(
+        horizon_hours=24, time_step_minutes=15, target_temp=cfg["target_temperature"],
+        min_temp=cfg["min_temperature"], max_temp=cfg["max_temperature"]))
+    outdoor, wind, rain, sun = weather(weather_p, START)
+    state = ThermalState(
+        room_temperature=21.0, slab_temperature=22.0, outdoor_temperature=float(outdoor[0]),
+        dhw_temperature=tank_c, dhw_hours_since_legionella=20.0, upper_floor_temperature=21.0,
+        lower_floor_temperature=21.0, buffer_tank_temperature=40.0)
+    if SUPPORTED and HYSTERESIS is not None:
+        state.dhw_start_hysteresis_k = HYSTERESIS
+    if STEP_SUPPORTED and STEP_C is not None:
+        from heatpump_optimizer.inputs import SetpointGrid
+
+        state.dhw_setpoint_grid = SetpointGrid("°C", STEP_C, None, None)
+    price = np.asarray(prices(price_p, START), dtype=float)
+    result = opt.optimize(inputs=solve_inputs(
+        initial_state=state, prices=price, outdoor_temps=outdoor, wind_speeds=wind,
+        precipitation=rain, solar_radiation=sun, start_time=START))
+    return (np.asarray(result.dhw_power_schedule, dtype=float),
+            np.asarray(result.dhw_temp_trajectory, dtype=float), price)
+
+
+def main() -> int:
+    total = {"runs": 0, 2: 0, 4: 0, 6: 0}
+    kwh = kwh_4k = deficit = cost = 0.0
+    write_max = float("-inf")
+    digest = hashlib.sha1()
+    for price_p in ("winter_typical", "flat"):
+        for weather_p in ("winter_cold", "winter_mild", "summer_warm"):
+            for tank_c in (45.0, 50.0, 53.0):
+                plan, temps, price = solve(price_p, weather_p, tank_c)
+                digest.update(np.round(plan, 9).tobytes() + np.round(temps, 9).tobytes())
+                on = plan > 0.0
+                kwh += float(plan.sum()) * DT_H
+                cost += float((plan * price[: plan.size]).sum()) * DT_H
+                deficit += float(np.clip(FLOOR_C - temps, 0.0, None).sum())
+                for i in range(1, plan.size):
+                    if not on[i] or on[i - 1]:
+                        continue
+                    end = i + int(np.argmin(np.append(on[i:], False)))
+                    total["runs"] += 1
+                    for k in (2, 4, 6):
+                        total[k] += int(temps[i] >= WRITTEN_C - k)
+                    if temps[i] >= WRITTEN_C - 4:
+                        kwh_4k += float(plan[i:end].sum()) * DT_H
+                        write_max = max(write_max, float(temps[i]) + 4.0)
+    shown = "unset" if HYSTERESIS is None else f"{HYSTERESIS:g}" if SUPPORTED else "unsupported"
+    print(f"RESULT hysteresis={shown}")
+    if STEP_C is not None or SETPOINT_C != 55.0:
+        step = "none" if STEP_C is None else f"{STEP_C:g}" + ("" if STEP_SUPPORTED else " unsupported")
+        print(f"RESULT setpoint={SETPOINT_C:g} step={step} written={WRITTEN_C:g} degC")
+    print(f"RESULT runs_not_at_step0={total['runs']} count")
+    for k in (2, 4, 6):
+        print(f"RESULT runs_at_or_above_minus_{k}k={total[k]} count")
+    print(f"RESULT kwh_planned={kwh:.2f} kWh")
+    print(f"RESULT kwh_at_or_above_minus_4k={kwh_4k:.2f} kWh")
+    print("RESULT write_to_start_max_c=" + ("none" if write_max == float("-inf") else f"{write_max:.1f} degC"))
+    print(f"RESULT floor_deficit_k_steps={deficit:.2f} K*steps")
+    print(f"RESULT dhw_cost={cost:.2f} price-units")
+    print(f"RESULT plan_sha1={digest.hexdigest()}")
+    print("RESULT repair_rounds_max=" + (f"{max(ROUNDS)} of {len(ROUNDS)} placements" if ROUNDS else "none"))
+    return 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(main())
diff --git a/dev/audit/harnesses/r10_dhw_start_hysteresis_mutants.py b/dev/audit/harnesses/r10_dhw_start_hysteresis_mutants.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000..665fcad57a
--- /dev/null
+++ b/dev/audit/harnesses/r10_dhw_start_hysteresis_mutants.py
@@ -0,0 +1,81 @@
+"""R10-OUTSIDE-DHW-START-HYSTERESIS: the named mutants of the start-hysteresis build.
+
+Applies each mutant, one at a time, to the production file it names under a
+checkout, runs ``tests/block_duty.py`` there, prints KILLED or SURVIVED with
+the failing check names, and restores the file.
+
+    python3 dev/audit/harnesses/r10_dhw_start_hysteresis_mutants.py WORKTREE [M1 M4 NULL ...]
+
+WORKTREE is a checkout to mutate in place: a ``git worktree`` of the head,
+never the tree a gate is running in. With no names every mutant runs. A
+mutant whose anchor text is not found exactly once prints ANCHOR and is not
+run, so a moved line reads as unproven, never as killed.
+Null control: the NULL mutant changes a comment only and must print SURVIVED;
+a harness that kills it is failing for a reason of its own.
+"""
+import subprocess, sys, os
+W = sys.argv[1]
+CC = os.path.join(W, "custom_components/heatpump_optimizer")
+M = [
+ ("M1 lift owner returns the configured lift", "thermal_model.py", "    return lift if hysteresis is None else max(lift, hysteresis)\n", "    return lift\n"),
+ ("M2 drop_unstartable >= to >", "dhw_planner.py", "        if temps_of(plan)[i] >= start_below[i]:", "        if temps_of(plan)[i] > start_below[i]:"),
+ ("M3 ledger not-startable branch removed", "pump_arbiter.py", '    if planned == "dhw" and actual == "idle" and _not_startable(row):\n        return "not-startable"\n', ""),
+ ("M4 repair places without the start mask", "dhw_planner.py", "            usable &= startable_steps(plan, temps, start_below)[lo : b + 1]\n", ""),
+ ("M5 startable_steps < to <=", "dhw_planner.py", "[: on.size] < start_below[: on.size]\n", "[: on.size] <= start_below[: on.size]\n"),
+ ("M6 a zero hysteresis is a start condition", "thermal_model.py", "hysteresis is None or hysteresis <= 0.0:", "hysteresis is None or hysteresis < 0.0:"),
+ ("M7 the difference reader ignores the unit's scale", "inputs.py", "    delta_k = value * scale\n", "    delta_k = value\n"),
+ ("M8 the cycle step judged against the everyday target", "dhw_planner.py", "        start[cycle_step] = dhw_start_below_c(dhw_step_target_c(params, True, grid), hysteresis_k)\n", "        pass\n"),
+ ("M9 notice at a minimum equal to the start temperature", "setpoint_check.py", "start is not None and floor > start,", "start is not None and floor >= start,"),
+ ("M10 place_startable returns without the final drop", "dhw_planner.py", "        plan = fixed\n    return drop_unstartable(plan, start_below, temps_of)\n", "        plan = fixed\n    return plan\n"),
+ ("M11 coordinator does not read the options", "coordinator.py", "        read_start_hysteresis(state, self.hass, self.effective_config)\n", ""),
+ ("M12 the floor write ignores the hysteresis", "pump_arbiter.py", 'start_flow_min_lift_k(inp.config, getattr(inp.state, "space_start_hysteresis_k", None)),', "start_flow_min_lift_k(inp.config, None),"),
+ ("M13 the planner ignores the hysteresis", "dhw_planner.py", "dhw_start_temps(params, initial_state, n_steps, legionella_step)", "dhw_start_temps(params, type(initial_state)(), n_steps, legionella_step)"),
+ ("M14 ledger start ignores the written target", "pump_arbiter.py", "dhw_start_below_c(_dhw_target(inp), hysteresis)", "dhw_start_below_c(dhw_step_target_c(inp.params, False), hysteresis)"),
+ ("M15 delta reader accepts above the maximum", "inputs.py", "    return delta_k if 0.0 <= delta_k <= TEMPERATURE_DELTA_MAX_K else None", "    return delta_k if 0.0 <= delta_k else None"),
+ ("M16 a run at step 0 is judged too", "dhw_planner.py", "    for i in np.flatnonzero(on[1:] & ~on[:-1]) + 1:\n", "    for i in np.flatnonzero(on & ~np.append(False, on[:-1])):\n"),
+ ("M17 the round bound is nine", "dhw_planner.py", "STARTABLE_ROUNDS = 8\n", "STARTABLE_ROUNDS = 9\n"),
+ ("M18 a cycle on the first step is not a cycle step", "dhw_planner.py", "if cycle_step is not None and 0 <= cycle_step < n_steps:", "if cycle_step is not None and 0 < cycle_step < n_steps:"),
+ ("M19 a run at the second step is not judged", "dhw_planner.py", "    for i in np.flatnonzero(on[1:] & ~on[:-1]) + 1:\n", "    for i in np.flatnonzero(on[2:] & ~on[1:-1]) + 2:\n"),
+ ("M20 the loop never ends early", "dhw_planner.py", "        if np.array_equal(fixed, plan):\n", "        if False:\n"),
+ ("M21 a cycle past the horizon is written", "dhw_planner.py", "if cycle_step is not None and 0 <= cycle_step < n_steps:", "if cycle_step is not None and 0 <= cycle_step <= n_steps:"),
+ ("M22 the shared clamp zeroes a step on the runnable block", "dhw_planner.py", "        return np.where(plan < ctx.min_run_power - 1e-9, 0.0, plan)\n", "        return np.where(plan <= ctx.min_run_power - 1e-9, 0.0, plan)\n"),
+ ("M23 no step is a cycle step for the write or the ledger", "pump_arbiter.py", '    cycle = (inp.action or {}).get("dhw_reason") == REASON_LEGIONELLA or inp.disinfecting\n', "    cycle = False\n"),
+ ("M24 the set-point check never reaches the start notice", "setpoint_check.py", "    _dhw_start(hass, config, params)\n", "    pass\n"),
+ ("M25 the notice judges the cycle's target", "setpoint_check.py", "    target = dhw_step_target_c(params, False, setpoint_grid(", "    target = dhw_step_target_c(params, True, setpoint_grid("),
+ ("M26 a hysteresis under one kelvin is none", "thermal_model.py", "hysteresis is None or hysteresis <= 0.0:", "hysteresis is None or hysteresis <= 1.0:"),
+ ("M27 pinned hot water is not held to the tank's capacity", "dhw_planner.py", "            schedule = self._ctx_clamp(\n                ctx, initial_state.dhw_temperature, draw_rates, max_temp, schedule)\n", "            pass\n"),
+ ("M28 the write and the ledger ignore the entity's grid", "pump_arbiter.py", 'return dhw_step_target_c(inp.params, cycle, _grid(inp, "dhw_setpoint"))', "return dhw_step_target_c(inp.params, cycle, None)"),
+ ("M29 the planner ignores the entity's grid", "dhw_planner.py", "hysteresis_k, grid = state.dhw_start_hysteresis_k, state.dhw_setpoint_grid\n", "hysteresis_k, grid = state.dhw_start_hysteresis_k, None\n"),
+ ("M30 the notice ignores the entity's grid", "setpoint_check.py", "dhw_step_target_c(params, False, setpoint_grid(hass, cfg.dhw_setpoint_entity))", "dhw_step_target_c(params, False)"),
+ ("M31 the notice is raised with hot water disabled", "setpoint_check.py", "bool(params.dhw_enabled) and start is not None", "start is not None"),
+ ("M32 the everyday target ignores the charge limit", "thermal_model.py", "(params.dhw_setpoint, params.dhw_max_temp) if target is None", "(params.dhw_setpoint, 1e9) if target is None"),
+ ("M33 the cycle's target ignores the hard maximum", "thermal_model.py", "else (target, params.dhw_hard_max_temp)", "else (target, 1e9)"),
+ ("M34 the input read leaves the grid off the state", "inputs.py", "    state.dhw_setpoint_grid = setpoint_grid(hass, cfg.dhw_setpoint_entity)\n", ""),
+ ("M35 the step after a charge the pump would not start is startable", "dhw_planner.py", "        under_way = bool(on[i] and ok[i])\n", "        under_way = bool(on[i])\n"),
+ ("M36 a charge at the first step carries nothing on", "dhw_planner.py", "    under_way = bool(on[:1].any())\n", "    under_way = False\n"),
+ ("M37 no charge under way carries on", "dhw_planner.py", "        ok[i] |= under_way\n", "        pass\n"),
+ ("M38 an entity with no state has a grid", "inputs.py", "    if not entity_id or hass.states.get(entity_id) is None:\n        return None\n    return _grid_of", "    if not entity_id:\n        return None\n    return _grid_of"),
+ ("M39 with no entity the target ignores its bound", "thermal_model.py", "        return min(float(value), float(limit))\n", "        return float(value)\n"),
+ ("M40 the hot-water write goes to an entity with no state", "pump_arbiter.py", 'return None if _grid(inp, "dhw_setpoint") is None else _dhw_target(inp)', "return _dhw_target(inp)"),
+ ("M41 the bound is handed to the grid as the value's own", "thermal_model.py", "grid.bounded(float(value), hi=limit)", "grid.bounded(float(value), hi=float(value))"),
+ ("M42 a charge kept at the first step is itself startable on a warm tank", "dhw_planner.py", "    under_way = bool(on[:1].any())\n", "    under_way = bool(on[:1].any())\n    ok[:1] |= on[:1]\n"),
+ ("M43 the notice is never raised", "setpoint_check.py", "        bool(params.dhw_enabled) and start is not None and floor > start,\n", "        False,\n"),
+ ("NULL comment-only change", "dhw_planner.py", "    on = plan > 0.0\n    for i in", "    on = plan > 0.0  # null mutant\n    for i in"),
+]
+only = sys.argv[2:] 
+for name, f, old, new in M:
+    if only and name.split()[0] not in only: continue
+    p = os.path.join(CC, f); src = open(p).read()
+    if src.count(old) != 1:
+        print(f"{name}: ANCHOR x{src.count(old)}"); continue
+    open(p, "w").write(src.replace(old, new))
+    try:
+        r = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "tests/block_duty.py"], cwd=W, capture_output=True, text=True,
+                           env={**os.environ, "PYTHONPATH": "tests/hastub"}, timeout=600)
+        fails = [l.strip() for l in (r.stdout + r.stderr).splitlines() if l.strip().startswith("FAIL")]
+        tail = (r.stdout + r.stderr).strip().splitlines()[-1][:160] if not fails else ""
+        print(f"{name}: {'KILLED' if r.returncode else 'SURVIVED'} rc={r.returncode} {len(fails)} failing")
+        for l in fails[:6]: print("    " + l[:170])
+        if r.returncode and not fails: print("    " + tail)
+    finally:
+        open(p, "w").write(src)
diff --git a/dev/audit/harnesses/r10_disinfection_setpoint.py b/dev/audit/harnesses/r10_disinfection_setpoint.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000..ddc1d706a7
--- /dev/null
+++ b/dev/audit/harnesses/r10_disinfection_setpoint.py
@@ -0,0 +1,153 @@
+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""The hot-water set-point the arbiter writes, and the repair it meets (R10-OUTSIDE-DISINFECTION-SETPOINT).
+
+Written by the group's fixer: the feature-triage seat's probe was not
+committed. Drives the production ``pump_arbiter.desired`` and
+``setpoint_check._dhw`` with the production ``ThermalParameters`` over every
+row of ``desired`` (baseline, idle, space, dhw, both) and every way a step
+books a cycle (none, the step's ``dhw_reason`` legionella, the disinfection
+switch held, both), on a hot-water set-point number of range 30-65 degC,
+step 1, no mode entity (so the space row is the hot-water gate). Run it from
+a worktree root, at the base and at the head, and diff the two outputs:
+
+    PYTHONPATH=tests/hastub:custom_components:tests \\
+        python3 dev/audit/harnesses/r10_disinfection_setpoint.py
+
+One line per install, booking and row: ``write=<degC>`` the hot-water write,
+then ``repair_own=`` / ``repair_none=`` the repair's Fix value (``-`` when it
+stands down) with the pump reading the arbiter's own write, and with the same
+reading on an install whose arbiter has written nothing. Installs:
+  * ``stock`` -- everyday 55, disinfection 60, cycle enabled: the defect.
+  * ``offstep`` -- disinfection 60.3: the rounding of the cycle's target.
+  * ``null_disabled`` -- the cycle disabled (null control).
+  * ``null_at`` / ``null_above`` -- everyday 60 / 62 (null controls).
+  * ``null_noentity`` -- no hot-water set-point entity (null control).
+Every ``null_*`` line is byte-identical at the base and the head; a
+``stock`` line differing is the fix.
+
+``--grid`` instead prints the census of the write's rounding paths, one
+``grid`` line per arm, entity step (0.1, 0.5, 1, 2, 5; range 30-80 degC),
+everyday set-point and disinfection temperature (below, at and above each
+other, on and off each step, past the 70 degC cap). Arms: ``held`` (cycle
+enabled, switch held: the cycle write), ``idle`` (cycle enabled, not running)
+and ``disabled`` (cycle disabled, switch held): the everyday write.
+``write=`` the dhw row's write; ``hard_max=`` the same parameters'
+``dhw_hard_max_temp``, ``over=1`` where the write exceeds it; ``limit=`` the
+charge limit ``dhw_max_temp``, ``over_limit=1`` where the write exceeds it;
+``below_floor=1`` where the write is under ``dhw_min_temp`` plus
+``DHW_MIN_TEMP_SETPOINT_MARGIN`` (no step between the two bounds); ``fix=``
+the repair's Fix value with no arbiter write and the pump reading 30
+(``-`` when it stands down), ``fix_over=1`` where it exceeds ``hard_max``.
+"""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import sys
+from datetime import datetime, timezone
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+
+sys.path.insert(0, "tests")
+sys.path.insert(0, "custom_components")
+
+from harness import FakeHass, FakeState  # noqa: E402
+from heatpump_optimizer import pump_arbiter as arb  # noqa: E402
+from heatpump_optimizer import setpoint_check  # noqa: E402
+from heatpump_optimizer.const import DHW_MIN_TEMP_SETPOINT_MARGIN, MODE_AUTO  # noqa: E402
+from heatpump_optimizer.thermal_model import ThermalParameters  # noqa: E402
+
+NOW = datetime(2026, 7, 1, 12, 0, tzinfo=timezone.utc)
+INSTALLS = {
+    "stock": dict(configured=55.0, disinfection=60.0, cycle=True, entity="number.dhw"),
+    "offstep": dict(configured=55.0, disinfection=60.3, cycle=True, entity="number.dhw"),
+    "null_disabled": dict(configured=55.0, disinfection=60.0, cycle=False, entity="number.dhw"),
+    "null_at": dict(configured=60.0, disinfection=60.0, cycle=True, entity="number.dhw"),
+    "null_above": dict(configured=62.0, disinfection=60.0, cycle=True, entity="number.dhw"),
+    "null_noentity": dict(configured=55.0, disinfection=60.0, cycle=True, entity=None),
+}
+BOOKINGS = {
+    "none": ({}, False),
+    "booked": ({"dhw_reason": "legionella"}, False),
+    "held": ({}, True),
+    "both": ({"dhw_reason": "legionella"}, True),
+}
+DUTIES = (None, "idle", "space", "dhw", "both")
+GRID_STEPS = (0.1, 0.5, 1, 2, 5)
+GRID_TEMPS = (50.0, 55.0, 57.0, 58.0, 60.0, 60.2, 60.3, 60.4, 60.7, 62.0, 69.6, 70.0, 72.0)
+
+
+class _Coord:
+    def __init__(self, snap):
+        self._snap = snap
+
+    def arbiter_inputs(self):
+        return self._snap
+
+
+def _snap(install, action, disinfecting, reading, attrs=None):
+    params = ThermalParameters(
+        dhw_setpoint=install["configured"], dhw_legionella_temp=install["disinfection"],
+        dhw_legionella_enabled=install["cycle"], dhw_min_temp=40.0,
+    )
+    entity = install["entity"]
+    states = {} if entity is None else {
+        entity: FakeState(str(reading), attributes=attrs or {"min": 30, "max": 65, "step": 1}),
+    }
+    snap = arb.ArbiterInputs(
+        hass=FakeHass(states), config={"pump_duty_mode": "control", "dhw_setpoint_entity": entity},
+        mode=MODE_AUTO, plan=None, plan_stale=False, entry_released=False,
+        state=SimpleNamespace(room_temperature=21.0, outdoor_temperature=5.0, dhw_temperature=50.0),
+        thermal=None, params=params, action=action, measured_power_kw=None, disinfecting=disinfecting,
+    )
+    return snap
+
+
+def _repair(snap, own):
+    coord = _Coord(snap)
+    if own is not None:
+        arb.state_for(coord).written["dhw_setpoint"] = (own, NOW)
+    setpoint_check._dhw(snap.hass, snap.config, snap.params, lambda pump: arb.dhw_gated(coord, pump))
+    raised = [i for i in getattr(snap.hass, "issues", []) if i[1] == setpoint_check.ISSUE_DHW]
+    return f"{raised[0][2]['data']['value']:g}" if raised else "-"
+
+
+GRID_ARMS = {"held": (True, True), "idle": (True, False), "disabled": (False, True)}
+
+
+def grid() -> int:
+    for arm, (cycle, disinfecting) in GRID_ARMS.items():
+        for step in GRID_STEPS:
+            for everyday in GRID_TEMPS[:-1]:
+                for disinfection in GRID_TEMPS:
+                    install = dict(configured=everyday, disinfection=disinfection, cycle=cycle, entity="number.dhw")
+                    attrs = {"min": 30, "max": 80, "step": step}
+                    snap = _snap(install, {}, disinfecting, 0.0, attrs)
+                    own = arb.desired(_Coord(snap), snap, "dhw", NOW).dhw_setpoint
+                    p = snap.params
+                    top, limit = p.dhw_hard_max_temp, p.dhw_max_temp
+                    floor = p.dhw_min_temp + DHW_MIN_TEMP_SETPOINT_MARGIN
+                    fix = _repair(_snap(install, {}, disinfecting, 30.0, attrs), None)
+                    print(f"grid arm={arm} step={step} everyday={everyday} disinfection={disinfection} "
+                          f"write={own} hard_max={top} over={int(own is not None and own > top + 1e-9)} "
+                          f"limit={limit} over_limit={int(own is not None and own > limit + 1e-9)} "
+                          f"below_floor={int(own is not None and own < floor - 1e-9)} "
+                          f"fix={fix} fix_over={int(fix != '-' and float(fix) > top + 1e-9)}")
+    return 0
+
+
+def main() -> int:
+    if sys.argv[1:] == ["--grid"]:
+        return grid()
+    for name, install in INSTALLS.items():
+        for booking, (action, disinfecting) in BOOKINGS.items():
+            for duty in DUTIES:
+                snap = _snap(install, action, disinfecting, 0.0)
+                own = arb.desired(_Coord(snap), snap, duty, NOW).dhw_setpoint
+                reading = 55.0 if own is None else own
+                with_own = _snap(install, action, disinfecting, reading)
+                without = _snap(install, action, disinfecting, reading)
+                print(f"{name} {booking} {duty} write={own} "
+                      f"repair_own={_repair(with_own, own)} repair_none={_repair(without, None)}")
+    return 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(main())
diff --git a/dev/audit/harnesses/r10_duty_switch_price_section.py b/dev/audit/harnesses/r10_duty_switch_price_section.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000..6f6895aca6
--- /dev/null
+++ b/dev/audit/harnesses/r10_duty_switch_price_section.py
@@ -0,0 +1,223 @@
+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Run R10-DUTY-SWITCH-PLANNER-PRICE's section of ``tests/features.py`` alone, and its mutants.
+
+WHY IT EXISTS. ``tests/features.py`` has no section filter, and the mutation
+proof of the group (the leg rule's leaf, the switch term, the lost running
+time, the banned candidate, the learner's count cap and its read for the
+planner) runs the section once per mutant. This cuts the section out of the
+script at its two markers, binds the six names the script had bound by then,
+and runs it. It executes the tree's own text: a check edited in
+``tests/features.py`` is the check run here.
+
+It refuses (exit 2) when a marker is missing or the section holds no check,
+so a moved marker cannot read as a pass.
+
+    PYTHONPATH=tests/hastub python3 dev/audit/harnesses/r10_duty_switch_price_section.py
+    PYTHONPATH=tests/hastub python3 dev/audit/harnesses/r10_duty_switch_price_section.py --mutants [name ...]
+
+``--mutants`` copies the package and ``tests/`` to a private directory per
+mutant, applies one edit there (the tree is never written), runs the section
+on the copy and prints the checks that went red. An unmutated copy runs
+first as the control and must pass. A mutant whose pattern is not found
+exactly once, or that turns no check red, is printed as such and the exit
+code is 1. The coordinator's one argument is outside the section (its check
+sits beside #1512's in the lifecycle part of the script) and is proven by a
+whole run of ``tests/features.py``.
+"""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import os
+import shutil
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import tempfile
+from pathlib import Path
+
+
+def repo_root(start):
+    """The directory holding custom_components/heatpump_optimizer/manifest.json."""
+    from pathlib import Path
+    here = Path(start).resolve()
+    if here.is_file():
+        here = here.parent
+    marker = Path("custom_components") / "heatpump_optimizer" / "manifest.json"
+    for cand in (here, *here.parents):
+        if (cand / marker).is_file():
+            return cand
+    raise RuntimeError(f"no repository root above {start}")
+
+
+ROOT = repo_root(os.environ.get("DSP_SECTION_ROOT") or __file__)
+START = "from types import SimpleNamespace as _DspNS"
+END = '\nsys.exit(R.close("FEATURE CHECKS"))'
+PRELUDE = """
+from datetime import datetime, timedelta
+import numpy as np
+from harness import Results, UTC
+from profiles import solve_inputs
+R = Results("R10-DUTY-SWITCH-PLANNER-PRICE's section of tests/features.py")
+"""
+PKG = "custom_components/heatpump_optimizer/"
+
+#: name, file, the text to find exactly once, its replacement.
+MUTANTS: list[tuple[str, str, str, str]] = [
+    ("optimizer: a candidate is tried with no requirement to hold it to", PKG + "optimizer.py",
+     "if kept_requirement is None or not duty_legs.switch_weight(", "if not duty_legs.switch_weight("),
+    ("optimizer: a candidate pass that raises is not caught", PKG + "optimizer.py",
+     "    except Exception as err:  # noqa: BLE001 - a candidate is optional", "    except KeyError as err:  # a candidate is optional"),
+    ("learner: no count cap", PKG + "duty_switch.py",
+     "        if self.n > N_CAP:\n", "        if False:\n"),
+    ("learner: the cap scales the stops alone", PKG + "duty_switch.py",
+     "self.k, self.kept_w = self.k * scale, self.kept_w * scale", "self.k = self.k * scale"),
+    ("learner: the cap is three times the on-threshold", PKG + "duty_switch.py",
+     "N_CAP = 2.0 * N_ON", "N_CAP = 3.0 * N_ON"),
+    ("learner: the read ignores the latch", PKG + "duty_switch.py",
+     "read = [d if d.usable else Direction() for", "read = [d for"),
+    ("learner: the read swaps the directions", PKG + "duty_switch.py",
+     "return (read[0].p, read[1].p), (read[0].median_off_s or 0.0, read[1].median_off_s or 0.0)",
+     "return (read[1].p, read[0].p), (read[1].median_off_s or 0.0, read[0].median_off_s or 0.0)"),
+    ("learner: the read hands the off time of the other direction", PKG + "duty_switch.py",
+     "(read[0].median_off_s or 0.0, read[1].median_off_s or 0.0)",
+     "(read[1].median_off_s or 0.0, read[0].median_off_s or 0.0)"),
+    ("leaf: the hot-water-to-heating switch reads the other direction", PKG + "duty_legs.py",
+     "(before == DHW) & (after == SPACE),\n        p_ds,", "(before == DHW) & (after == SPACE),\n        p_sd,"),
+    ("leaf: the switch weight takes the larger neighbouring draw", PKG + "duty_legs.py",
+     "np.minimum(level[_BEFORE], level[_AFTER])", "np.maximum(level[_BEFORE], level[_AFTER])"),
+    ("leaf: the in-step weight draws the smaller circuit, not the combined draw", PKG + "duty_legs.py",
+     "np.where(two, p_ds * level, 0.0)",
+     "np.where(two, p_ds * np.minimum(space, np.asarray(dhw_kw, dtype=float)), 0.0)"),
+    ("leaf: the weight is not divided by the maximum draw", PKG + "duty_legs.py",
+     "axis=1)) / p_max", "axis=1))"),
+    ("leaf: a small hot-water share no longer collapses to heating", PKG + "duty_legs.py",
+     "to_space = both & (dhw_min < SPLIT_MIN_MINUTES)", "to_space = both & (dhw_min > SPLIT_MIN_MINUTES)"),
+    ("leaf: a small heating share no longer collapses to hot water", PKG + "duty_legs.py",
+     "~to_space & (step_minutes - dhw_min < SPLIT_MIN_MINUTES)",
+     "~to_space & (step_minutes - dhw_min > SPLIT_MIN_MINUTES)"),
+    ("leaf: the leg classification ignores the duty floor", PKG + "duty_legs.py",
+     "_runs(space, floor), _runs(dhw, floor)", "_runs(space, None), _runs(dhw, None)"),
+    # The leaf has no zero-pair return: zero probabilities weigh zero on the
+    # full path, and the optimizer never calls it without a priced direction.
+    ("leaf: a pump with no maximum draw is not returned early", PKG + "duty_legs.py",
+     "    if p_max <= 0:\n        return np.zeros(space.shape[0])", "    if p_max < 0:\n        return np.zeros(space.shape[0])"),
+    ("leaf: a negative learned value is kept", PKG + "duty_legs.py",
+     "max(v, 0.0) if math.isfinite(v) and v <= upper", "v if math.isfinite(v) and v <= upper"),
+    ("leaf: a learned value on its upper bound reads as zero", PKG + "duty_legs.py",
+     "max(v, 0.0) if math.isfinite(v) and v <= upper", "max(v, 0.0) if math.isfinite(v) and v < upper"),
+    ("leaf: the early return is one entry per step, not per row", PKG + "duty_legs.py",
+     "return np.zeros(space.shape[0])", "return np.zeros(space.shape[1])"),
+    ("optimizer: no priced direction still returns a pair", PKG + "optimizer.py",
+     "return stops if max(stops) > 0 else None", "return stops"),
+    ("leaf: the charged step is the hot-water block's last step", PKG + "duty_legs.py",
+     "charged[1:] |= (last[:-1] == DHW) & (first[1:] == SPACE)",
+     "charged[:-1] |= (last[:-1] == DHW) & (first[1:] == SPACE)"),
+    ("leaf: the delivered draw is keyed on the clamped install", PKG + "duty_legs.py",
+     "    if floor is None:\n        return space_kw", "    if floor is not None:\n        return space_kw"),
+    ("leaf: the delivered draw loses only the space share", PKG + "duty_legs.py",
+     "(1.0 - avail) * (space_kw + dhw_kw)", "(1.0 - avail) * space_kw"),
+    ("optimizer: the switch term is handed the delivered draw", PKG + "optimizer.py",
+     "switch_cost(space_power, dhw_plan_power)", "switch_cost(heat_power, dhw_plan_power)"),
+    ("optimizer: the simulation is handed the shipped draw", PKG + "optimizer.py",
+     "_space_traj(heat_power, buffer_exo_kw)", "_space_traj(space_power, buffer_exo_kw)"),
+    ("optimizer: the energy cost is handed the shipped draw", PKG + "optimizer.py",
+     "drawn = combined if heat_power is space_power else heat_power + dhw_plan_power",
+     "drawn = combined"),
+    ("optimizer: the publication drops the solve's availability vector", PKG + "optimizer.py",
+     "heat_space = optimal_space if self._space_avail is None else duty_legs",
+     "heat_space = optimal_space if True else duty_legs"),
+    ("planner: the placement ban is not OR'd into forced_off", PKG + "dhw_planner.py",
+     "return forced_off if ban is None else _forced_off_with(forced_off, ban, n_steps)",
+     "return forced_off"),
+    ("optimizer: a candidate short of its requirement is adopted", PKG + "optimizer.py",
+     "            and first_short(plan.schedule, requirement, unheld)[1] is None\n",
+     "            and True\n"),
+    ("optimizer: a candidate with hot water on a banned step is adopted", PKG + "optimizer.py",
+     "            not np.any(plan.schedule[ban & ~forced_on] > 0)\n", "            True\n"),
+    ("optimizer: the candidate is adopted on a higher score", PKG + "optimizer.py",
+     "if score < base - 1e-9:", "if score > base - 1e-9:"),
+    ("leaf: the lost share is not capped at one", PKG + "duty_legs.py",
+     "return min(1.0, stop_probability[0] * off_seconds[0] / (step_minutes * 60.0))",
+     "return stop_probability[0] * off_seconds[0] / (step_minutes * 60.0)"),
+    ("leaf: the lost share ignores the stop probability", PKG + "duty_legs.py",
+     "min(1.0, stop_probability[0] * off_seconds[0] /", "min(1.0, off_seconds[0] /"),
+    # The fix reviewer's three survivors at ee89d50b2b (R5, R9, R11), its texts.
+    ("optimizer: the co-optimisation headroom ignores the availability vector", PKG + "optimizer.py",
+     "p_max, dhw_power, self._space_avail, _duty_floor(self))", "p_max, dhw_power, None, _duty_floor(self))"),
+    ("optimizer: the availability vector is classified with no duty floor", PKG + "optimizer.py",
+     "return duty_legs.availability(space, tank, lost, _duty_floor(opt))",
+     "return duty_legs.availability(space, tank, lost, None)"),
+    ("optimizer: the candidate pass runs on a combi store", PKG + "optimizer.py",
+     "or not opt.config.cycling_cost > 0 or opt.model.params.dhw_store.combi:",
+     "or not opt.config.cycling_cost > 0:"),
+    ("optimizer: the co-optimisation headroom is handed no duty floor", PKG + "optimizer.py",
+     "p_max, dhw_power, self._space_avail, _duty_floor(self))", "p_max, dhw_power, self._space_avail, None)"),
+    # Repair round 2: the two clamps left on the line the availability reads
+    # its start through, the mutation table's CLAMP_DROP twins of one anchor.
+    ("optimizer: the start is read with no cap beside hot water", PKG + "optimizer.py",
+     "np.minimum(start, np.maximum(0.0, p_max - dhw_plan)),", "(start),"),
+    ("optimizer: the start is capped at zero in every step", PKG + "optimizer.py",
+     "np.minimum(start, np.maximum(0.0, p_max - dhw_plan)),", "np.minimum(start, (0.0)),"),
+    ("arbiter: the share serves the legs in reverse order", PKG + "pump_arbiter.py",
+     "return legs[0][0] if (now - result.timestamps[i]) < first_ends else legs[-1][0]",
+     "return legs[-1][0] if (now - result.timestamps[i]) < first_ends else legs[0][0]"),
+]
+
+
+def run_section(root: Path) -> int:
+    text = (root / "tests" / "features.py").read_text()
+    if text.count(START) != 1 or text.count(END) != 1:
+        print("REFUSED: a section marker is missing or repeated in tests/features.py")
+        return 2
+    section = text[text.index(START):text.index(END)]
+    sys.path[:0] = [str(root / "tests"), str(root / "custom_components")]
+    scope: dict = {"__name__": "duty_switch_price_section"}
+    exec(compile(PRELUDE + section, "tests/features.py[duty-switch-price]", "exec"), scope)
+    results = scope["R"]
+    if not results.checks:
+        print("REFUSED: the section ran no check")
+        return 2
+    return results.close("DUTY-SWITCH PLANNER-PRICE SECTION CHECKS")
+
+
+def _copy_run(edit: tuple[str, str, str] | None) -> tuple[int | None, list[str]]:
+    """The section's exit code and red check names on a private copy, ``None`` when the pattern is not there once."""
+    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
+        copy = Path(tmp)
+        for part in ("custom_components", "tests"):
+            shutil.copytree(ROOT / part, copy / part, ignore=shutil.ignore_patterns("__pycache__", "golden"))
+        if edit is not None:
+            path, old, new = edit
+            text = (copy / path).read_text()
+            if text.count(old) != 1:
+                return None, []
+            (copy / path).write_text(text.replace(old, new))
+        env = {**os.environ, "DSP_SECTION_ROOT": str(copy / "custom_components"),
+               "PYTHONPATH": str(copy / "tests" / "hastub"), "PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE": "1"}
+        out = subprocess.run([sys.executable, __file__], cwd=copy, env=env, capture_output=True, text=True)
+        red = [line[7:].split("  [")[0] for line in out.stdout.splitlines() if line.startswith("  FAIL ")]
+        if "SECTION CHECKS" not in out.stdout:  # a traceback exits 1 too, and closes nothing
+            red.append(f"the section stopped: {(out.stderr.strip().splitlines() or ['no output'])[-1]}")
+        return out.returncode, red
+
+
+def run_mutants(names: list[str]) -> int:
+    code, red = _copy_run(None)
+    print(f"== control, no edit: exit {code}, {len(red)} red")
+    if code != 0:
+        print("\n".join(f"     {name}" for name in red))
+        return 1
+    bad = 0
+    for name, path, old, new in MUTANTS:
+        if names and name not in names:
+            continue
+        code, red = _copy_run((path, old, new))
+        verdict = "PATTERN NOT FOUND ONCE" if code is None else f"{len(red)} red" if red else "SURVIVED"
+        bad += not red
+        print(f"== {name}: {verdict}")
+        print("\n".join(f"     {check}" for check in red), end="\n" if red else "")
+    print(f"RESULT mutants_not_killed={bad}")
+    return 1 if bad else 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    os.chdir(ROOT)
+    sys.exit(run_mutants(sys.argv[2:]) if sys.argv[1:2] == ["--mutants"] else run_section(ROOT))
diff --git a/dev/audit/harnesses/r10_duty_switch_section.py b/dev/audit/harnesses/r10_duty_switch_section.py

--- /dev/null

@@ -0,0 +1,70 @@
+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Run the duty-switch section of ``tests/features.py`` alone, in seconds.
+
+WHY IT EXISTS. ``tests/features.py`` has no section filter, and a mutation
+proof over the duty-switch learner (R10-DUTY-SWITCH-RESTART-LEARNING) runs
+it once per mutant. This cuts the section out of the script at its two
+markers, gives it the names the script had bound by then, and runs it, so
+one mutant costs the section and not the suite. It executes the tree's own
+text: a check edited in ``tests/features.py`` is the check run here.
+
+It refuses (exit 2) when a marker is missing or the section holds no check,
+so a moved marker cannot read as a pass.
+
+    PYTHONPATH=tests/hastub python3 dev/audit/harnesses/r10_duty_switch_section.py
+"""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+
+def repo_root(start):
+    """The directory holding custom_components/heatpump_optimizer/manifest.json."""
+    from pathlib import Path
+    here = Path(start).resolve()
+    if here.is_file():
+        here = here.parent
+    marker = Path("custom_components") / "heatpump_optimizer" / "manifest.json"
+    for cand in (here, *here.parents):
+        if (cand / marker).is_file():
+            return cand
+    raise RuntimeError(f"no repository root above {start}")
+
+
+ROOT = repo_root(__file__)
+START = "from heatpump_optimizer import duty_switch as _ds_mod"
+END = "# --- R10-CEILING-PROBE (#2498, #2808)"
+PRELUDE = """
+import json, asyncio as _asyncio
+from datetime import datetime, timedelta
+from pathlib import Path
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+from harness import FakeHass, FakeState, Results, UTC
+from homeassistant.util import dt as _sa_dt
+from heatpump_optimizer import boost as _sa_boost
+from heatpump_optimizer import pump_arbiter as _sa_pa
+from heatpump_optimizer import store as _sa_store
+R = Results("duty-switch section of tests/features.py")
+"""
+
+
+def main() -> int:
+    text = (ROOT / "tests" / "features.py").read_text()
+    if text.count(START) != 1 or text.count(END) != 1:
+        print("REFUSED: a section marker is missing or repeated in tests/features.py")
+        return 2
+    section = text[text.index(START):text.index(END)]
+    sys.path[:0] = [str(ROOT / "tests"), str(ROOT / "custom_components")]
+    scope: dict = {"__name__": "duty_switch_section"}
+    exec(compile(PRELUDE + section, "tests/features.py[duty-switch]", "exec"), scope)
+    results = scope["R"]
+    if not results.checks:
+        print("REFUSED: the section ran no check")
+        return 2
+    return results.close("DUTY-SWITCH SECTION CHECKS")
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    import os
+    os.chdir(ROOT)
+    sys.exit(main())

diff --git a/dev/audit/harnesses/r10_gate_defer_barrier.py b/dev/audit/harnesses/r10_gate_defer_barrier.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000..7b3c9bbce6
--- /dev/null
+++ b/dev/audit/harnesses/r10_gate_defer_barrier.py
@@ -0,0 +1,133 @@
+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""R10-GATE-DEFER-BARRIER: the finder's harness for two readers of a deferral gate red.
+
+    python3 -I dev/audit/harnesses/r10_gate_defer_barrier.py [--tree DIR]
+
+DIR is a tree root holding tools/audit/seat/ (merge_train.py, gh_read.py) and tools/ci/gate.py (default:
+this tree). To measure a baseline, export it first:
+
+    git archive <sha> tools/audit/seat tools/ci | tar -x -C "$D" && python3 -I ... --tree "$D"
+
+Arms, each driving the tree's own Train with a fake `gh` (no network):
+  policy   #3264's review instance: the rollup holds a passing `gate` (a CI review
+           run's) and a failing `gate` (the edit run's deferral). policy_refusal
+           must be a wait (second field True), not the park "the missing requirement
+           is a review". Null: a rollup of the passing gate alone is the park as before.
+  policy-real-red / policy-hidden-red   a real gate red beside an unrelated unfinished workflow, and another
+           required context's red beside a deferral gate, must both read red (no wait, the context named).
+  under    #3398's shape: a deferral red whose code run is in_progress, started and
+           inside its deadline, outlives `polls`; wait_ci must return [] once the run
+           ends, not ["TIMEOUT"]. Null: a QUEUED run keeps the polls bound (TIMEOUT).
+A line `DEFECT <arm>` is printed per arm that reads the defect, then RESULT lines;
+the exit code is 1 when any DEFECT stands, 0 otherwise.
+"""
+import argparse
+import datetime
+import importlib.util
+import json
+import sys
+import tempfile
+from pathlib import Path
+
+
+def load(tree: Path):
+    seat = tree / "tools/audit/seat"
+    sys.path.insert(0, str(seat))
+    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("mt_under_test", str(seat / "merge_train.py"))
+    mod = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
+    sys.modules["mt_under_test"] = mod
+    spec.loader.exec_module(mod)
+    return mod
+
+
+def policy(mt, rollup, ci=(), every=(), req=("gate",)):
+    H, NOW = "b" * 40, 1_000_000.0
+
+    def run(argv, cwd=None, stdin=None):
+        a = " ".join(argv)
+        if "workflows/ci.yml/runs?head_sha=" in a:
+            return 0, "".join(json.dumps(x) + "\n" for x in ci)
+        if "actions/runs?head_sha=" in a:
+            return 0, "".join(json.dumps(x) + "\n" for x in every)
+        if "actions/runs?event=pull_request_review" in a:
+            return 0, ""
+        if "statusCheckRollup" in a:
+            return 0, json.dumps({"mergeStateStatus": "BLOCKED", "reviewDecision": "APPROVED",
+                                  "statusCheckRollup": [r if isinstance(r, dict) else {"name": "gate", "conclusion": r}
+                                                        for r in rollup]})
+        if "/reviews" in a:
+            return 0, json.dumps([[]])
+        return 0, ""
+    t = mt.Train("o/r", Path("."), None, "", (), 1, run=run, sleep=lambda s: None, log=lambda s: None,
+                 polls=3, wall=lambda: NOW)
+    t.required = lambda pr_head=False: list(req)
+    return t.policy_refusal(3264, H)
+
+
+def under(mt, status, polls=3):
+    NOW = 1_800_000_000.0
+    started = datetime.datetime.fromtimestamp(NOW - 5000, datetime.timezone.utc).strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")
+    gate = {"name": "gate", "status": "completed", "conclusion": "failure", "started_at": "2026-11-06T14:55:00Z",
+            "id": 1, "check_suite": {"id": 11}}
+    green = dict(gate, conclusion="success", started_at="2026-11-06T15:26:00Z", id=3)
+    seen = [0, 0]
+
+    def run(argv, cwd=None, stdin=None):
+        a = " ".join(argv)
+        if "check-runs" in a:
+            cur = [gate] if seen[0] < 8 else [green]
+            seen[0] += 1
+            return 0, "\n".join(json.dumps(c) for c in cur)
+        if "actions/runs?head_sha=" in a:
+            seen[1] += 1
+            # the paged read's answer: one JSON object per line (`--jq .[]`), as merge_train.py's `pages` reads it
+            row = ({"id": 42237558473, "status": status, "run_started_at": started} if seen[1] <= 7
+                   else {"id": 42237558473, "status": "completed", "run_started_at": ""})
+            return 0, json.dumps(row) + "\n"
+        return 0, ""
+    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
+        t = mt.Train("o/r", Path(d), None, "", (), 1, run=run, sleep=lambda s: None, log=lambda s: None,
+                     polls=polls, wall=lambda: NOW)
+        return t.wait_ci("e" * 40, only=["gate"])
+
+
+def main() -> int:
+    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    ap.add_argument("--tree", default=str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3]))
+    mt = load(Path(ap.parse_args().tree))
+    defects = 0
+    got = policy(mt, ["SUCCESS", "FAILURE"])
+    bad = not (got[1] is True and "review" not in got[0].split("(")[0])
+    got0 = policy(mt, ["SUCCESS"])
+    print(f"RESULT policy_wait={got[1]} policy_text_names_review={'review' in got[0].split('(')[0]}")
+    print(f"RESULT policy_null_waits={got0[1]} (the passing gate alone must not wait)")
+    print(f"RESULT policy_null_ok={got0[1] is False}")
+    if bad:
+        print("DEFECT policy"); defects += 1
+    if got0[1] is not False:
+        print("DEFECT policy-null"); defects += 1
+    # a real red is never read as a deferral (the round-2 verdict's cases): the arm's DEFECT is a wait, or a hidden red
+    fail = lambda n, at: {"name": n, "conclusion": "FAILURE", "completedAt": at}  # noqa: E731
+    other = [{"id": 9, "name": "codeql", "status": "in_progress"}]
+    code = [{"id": 5, "status": "queued"}]
+    fast = "tests / fast (3.14)"
+    b = policy(mt, [fail("gate", "2026-11-12T09:55:00Z"), fail("gate", "2026-11-12T11:00:00Z")], every=other)
+    c = policy(mt, [fail("gate", "2026-11-12T09:55:00Z"), fail(fast, "2026-11-12T10:10:00Z")], ci=code, req=("gate", fast))
+    a = policy(mt, [fail("gate", "2026-11-12T09:55:00Z")], ci=code)
+    print(f"RESULT policy_B_wait={b[1]} policy_C_wait={c[1]} policy_C_names_fast={fast in c[0]} policy_A_wait={a[1]}")
+    if b[1] is not False:
+        print("DEFECT policy-real-red"); defects += 1
+    if c[1] is not False or fast not in c[0]:
+        print("DEFECT policy-hidden-red"); defects += 1
+    r = under(mt, "in_progress")
+    q = under(mt, "queued")
+    print(f"RESULT under_started={r} under_queued_null={q}")
+    if r != []:
+        print("DEFECT under"); defects += 1
+    if q != ["TIMEOUT"]:
+        print("DEFECT under-null"); defects += 1
+    return 1 if defects else 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    sys.exit(main())
diff --git a/dev/audit/harnesses/r10_gate_defer_barrier_mutants.py b/dev/audit/harnesses/r10_gate_defer_barrier_mutants.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000..2d0c9fb19e
--- /dev/null
+++ b/dev/audit/harnesses/r10_gate_defer_barrier_mutants.py
@@ -0,0 +1,140 @@
+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""R10-GATE-DEFER-BARRIER: mutants of the deferral barrier in merge_train.classify.
+
+    python3 -I dev/audit/harnesses/r10_gate_defer_barrier_mutants.py [--tree DIR] [--plants-only]
+
+DIR is a tree root holding tools/audit/seat/ and tools/ci/ (default: this tree); a baseline is measured by
+exporting it first (`git archive <sha> tools/audit/seat tools/ci | tar -x -C "$D"`, then `--tree "$D"`).
+
+Two arms. PLANT: one deferral-blind reader per shape the fourth blocked verdict named (import alias,
+rebinding, getattr, functools.partial, a function named *self_test*, a module outside the four the
+old scan read), each planted into a copy of DIR -- appended to tools/audit/seat/merge_train.py, or as
+custom_components/elsewhere.py for the outside module -- and driven on a red `gate`. A plant passes
+FINAL where DIR has it, else no busy (DIR's own blind spelling). It is KILLED when the read raises or
+DIR's `_gate_reader_barrier_self_test`, loaded from the copy, fails a check; SURVIVED when it returns
+a verdict and the block is green. SOURCE (skipped by --plants-only): each row of SOURCE_MUTANTS
+replaces one fragment of merge_train.py that must occur exactly once (else STALE, a failure), and the
+block runs over the mutated source compiled in memory under the file's path; the unmutated source
+is the null control and must fail nothing.
+A line per mutant, then `RESULT plants=N survived=S` and `RESULT mutants=N survived=S stale=T
+baseline_failed=F`; exit 1 unless every count but N is 0.
+"""
+import argparse
+import shutil
+import sys
+import tempfile
+import types
+from pathlib import Path
+
+_F = "_F = (FINAL,) if 'FINAL' in globals() else ()\n"
+PLANTS = [
+    ("import alias", "merge_train.py",
+     "def _planted(latest, required):\n    from merge_train import classify as judge\n    return judge(latest, required, *_F)\n"),
+    ("rebinding", "merge_train.py", "_judge = classify\ndef _planted(latest, required):\n    return _judge(latest, required, *_F)\n"),
+    ("getattr", "merge_train.py",
+     "def _planted(latest, required):\n    return getattr(sys.modules['merge_train'], 'classify')(latest, required, *_F)\n"),
+    ("functools.partial", "merge_train.py",
+     "def _planted(latest, required):\n    return functools.partial(classify, latest, required)(*_F)\n"),
+    ("a function named *self_test*", "merge_train.py",
+     "def _planted_self_test(latest, required):\n    return classify(latest, required, *_F)\n_planted = _planted_self_test\n"),
+    ("a module outside the four", "../../../custom_components/elsewhere.py",
+     "def _planted(latest, required):\n    return classify(latest, required, *_F)\n"),
+]
+
+SOURCE_MUTANTS = [
+    ("FINAL accepted from any frame", "elif busy is FINAL and caller_frame(1) in FINAL_READERS:", "elif busy is FINAL:"),
+    ("any value accepted as busy (None, (), a list)", "    if isinstance(busy, Busy):\n        deferred",
+     "    if isinstance(busy, (Busy, list, tuple, type(None))):\n        deferred"),
+    ("an empty Busy minted anywhere", "if not self and caller_frame(1) not in BUSY_MINTERS:", "if False:"),
+    ("FINAL frame read one level too shallow (classify itself)", "elif busy is FINAL and caller_frame(1) in FINAL_READERS:",
+     "elif busy is FINAL and caller_frame(0) in FINAL_READERS:"),
+    ("frames keyed by basename, not repo path", "return rel, code.co_qualname",
+     "return 'tools/audit/seat/' + Path(rel).name, code.co_qualname"),
+    ("frames keyed by path only", "return rel, code.co_qualname", "return rel, 'approval_owed'"),
+]
+
+
+def load(path: Path, source: str, name: str = "merge_train"):
+    mod = types.ModuleType(name)
+    mod.__file__ = str(path)
+    sys.modules[name] = mod
+    sys.path.insert(0, str(path.parent))
+    try:
+        exec(compile(source, str(path), "exec"), mod.__dict__)
+    finally:
+        sys.path.remove(str(path.parent))
+    return mod
+
+
+def block(mod) -> list:
+    failed = []
+    try:
+        mod._gate_reader_barrier_self_test(lambda name, ok: None if ok else failed.append(name))
+    except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001  a crash of the block is a failure of the block
+        failed.append(f"raised {type(e).__name__}: {e}")
+    return failed
+
+
+def plant(tree: Path, where: str, src: str) -> str:
+    """'KILLED <why>' or 'SURVIVED <verdict>' for one plant in a copy of <tree>."""
+    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
+        for sub in ("tools/audit/seat", "tools/ci"):
+            shutil.copytree(tree / sub, Path(d) / sub)
+        seat = Path(d) / "tools/audit/seat"
+        target = (seat / where).resolve()
+        mt_src = (seat / "merge_train.py").read_text()
+        if where == "merge_train.py":
+            mt_src += "\n" + _F + src
+            (seat / "merge_train.py").write_text(mt_src)
+        else:
+            target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+            target.write_text(_F + src)
+        mod = load(seat / "merge_train.py", mt_src)
+        if where == "merge_train.py":
+            reader = mod._planted
+        else:
+            ns = {k: v for k, v in mod.__dict__.items() if not k.startswith("__")}
+            exec(compile(target.read_text(), str(target), "exec"), ns)
+            reader = ns["_planted"]
+        red = mod.latest_runs([{"name": mod.GATE, "status": "completed", "conclusion": "failure", "started_at": "1"}])
+        try:
+            got = reader(red, [mod.GATE])
+        except TypeError as e:
+            return f"KILLED   read refused: {type(e).__name__}: {str(e)[:70]}"
+        failed = block(mod)
+        return f"KILLED   block: {failed[0][:70]}" if failed else f"SURVIVED read {got[0]}, block green"
+
+
+def main() -> int:
+    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    ap.add_argument("--tree", default=str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3]))
+    ap.add_argument("--plants-only", action="store_true")
+    args = ap.parse_args()
+    tree = Path(args.tree).resolve()
+    survived = 0
+    for name, where, src in PLANTS:
+        line = plant(tree, where, src)
+        survived += line.startswith("SURVIVED")
+        print(f"PLANT {name}: {line}")
+    print(f"RESULT plants={len(PLANTS)} survived={survived}")
+    if args.plants_only:
+        return 1 if survived else 0
+    path = tree / "tools/audit/seat/merge_train.py"
+    src = path.read_text()
+    base = block(load(path, src))
+    print(f"BASELINE failed={len(base)} {base[:2]}")
+    msurv = stale = 0
+    for name, old, new in SOURCE_MUTANTS:
+        if src.count(old) != 1:
+            stale += 1
+            print(f"STALE    {name} (fragment occurs {src.count(old)} times)")
+            continue
+        failed = block(load(path, src.replace(old, new)))
+        msurv += not failed
+        print(f"{'KILLED  ' if failed else 'SURVIVED'} {name} | {failed[0][:80] if failed else '-'} (+{max(len(failed) - 1, 0)})")
+    print(f"RESULT mutants={len(SOURCE_MUTANTS)} survived={msurv} stale={stale} baseline_failed={len(base)}")
+    return 1 if survived or msurv or stale or base else 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    sys.exit(main())

diff --git a/dev/audit/harnesses/r10_mutant_coverage.sh b/dev/audit/harnesses/r10_mutant_coverage.sh
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000..2667801d0b
--- /dev/null
+++ b/dev/audit/harnesses/r10_mutant_coverage.sh
@@ -0,0 +1,76 @@
+#!/usr/bin/env bash
+# R10-FIXER-MD-SPELLING-CORPUS carries 0 and 1: the measure-first behind
+# fixer.md step 2's "killing the diff's survivors is yours". Reproduces every
+# figure the pull request's body states from git alone (the bus refs) and
+# tools/audit/seat/mutant_run.py:
+#
+#   fetch                         the review/* and verdict/* bus refs, under refs/bus/
+#   blocks FROM UNTIL CLASS_RE    one line per (pr, head) blocked with a class
+#                                 matching CLASS_RE, verdict commit date in [FROM, UNTIL]:
+#                                 "<pr> <head> <first verdict time>"
+#   base HEAD TIME                main's first-parent tip at TIME, merged-based with HEAD:
+#                                 the diff base the fixer's prepr saw
+#   rank BASE HEAD FILE LINE..    the 1-based rank of the first listed mutant on each
+#                                 FILE:LINE in `mutant_run.py --diff --list` (cap 40 = rank <= 40),
+#                                 "none" when diff mode draws no mutant there
+#   repair PR HEAD                hours from the first block at HEAD to the next verdict
+#                                 at a different head (a same-head re-post is not a round)
+#   run BASE REV CMD [in-place]   wall seconds and SURVIVED lines of the capped report-only
+#                                 diff run at REV (in place: in a detached worktree at REV)
+#
+# RESULT window=168h — the coverage window is the 7 days before the merge base.
+# Null control: `run` at a head merged first pass (#3384, c620ebba^1...c620ebba^2)
+# reports survivors only inside orchestrator_tick.py's self_test(), none a
+# reviewer would name.
+set -u
+TOP=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel) || exit 2
+cd "$TOP" || exit 2
+MR=tools/audit/seat/mutant_run.py
+case "${1:-}" in
+  fetch)
+    git fetch -q origin '+refs/heads/review/*:refs/bus/review/*' '+refs/heads/verdict/*:refs/bus/verdict/*' ;;
+  blocks)
+    from=$2; until=$3; cls=$4
+    for r in $(git for-each-ref --format='%(refname)' refs/bus/review refs/bus/verdict); do
+      git log --format='%H %cI' --since="$from" --until="$until" "$r" | while read -r c d; do
+        l=$(git show "$c:VERDICT.md" 2>/dev/null | head -1)
+        if grep -Eq "^Fix review: blocked [0-9a-f]{40} ($cls):" <<<"$l"; then
+          echo "${r##*/} $(cut -d' ' -f4 <<<"$l") $d"
+        fi
+      done
+    done | sort -k1,1n -k2,2 -k3,3 | awk '!seen[$1" "$2]++' ;;
+  base)
+    git merge-base "$(git rev-list -1 --first-parent --before="$3" origin/main)" "$2" ;;
+  rank)
+    b=$2; h=$3; f=$4; shift 4
+    list=$(python3 -I "$MR" --diff "$b...$h" --cmd true --list --max-mutants 0 2>&1 | grep '^MUTANT ')
+    for l in "$@"; do
+      r=$(grep -n "^MUTANT $f:$l " <<<"$list" | head -1 | cut -d: -f1)
+      echo "$f:$l rank=${r:-none} of $(grep -c . <<<"$list")"
+    done ;;
+  repair)
+    pr=$2; h=$3; bt=""
+    while read -r t c; do
+      l=$(git show "$c:VERDICT.md" | head -1)
+      if [ -z "$bt" ]; then case "$l" in "Fix review: blocked $h "*) bt=$t ;; esac; continue; fi
+      case "$l" in *" $h"*) continue ;; esac
+      echo "$pr ${h:0:8} block=$(date -u -d "@$bt" +%FT%TZ) next=$(date -u -d "@$t" +%FT%TZ) hours=$(awk -v a="$bt" -v b="$t" 'BEGIN{printf "%.2f", (b-a)/3600}')"
+      exit 0
+    done < <(git log --reverse --format='%ct %H' "refs/bus/verdict/$pr")
+    echo "$pr ${h:0:8} block=${bt:+$(date -u -d "@$bt" +%FT%TZ)} next=none" ;;
+  run)
+    b=$2; rev=$3; cmd=$4; mode=${5:-}; W=""
+    if [ "$mode" = in-place ]; then
+      W=$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/mutcov.XXXXXX"); rmdir "$W"
+      git worktree add -q --detach "$W" "$rev" || exit 2
+      cd "$W" || exit 2; rev=HEAD; flag=--in-place
+    else flag=""; fi
+    s=$(date +%s.%N)
+    out=$(python3 -I "$MR" --diff "$b...$rev" --cmd "$cmd" --max-mutants 40 --report-only ${flag:+"$flag"} 2>&1); rc=$?
+    e=$(date +%s.%N)
+    grep -E '^(SURVIVED|BASELINE)' <<<"$out"
+    echo "rc=$rc wall_s=$(awk -v a="$s" -v b="$e" 'BEGIN{printf "%.1f", b-a}') survivors=$(grep -c '^SURVIVED' <<<"$out")"
+    if [ -n "$W" ]; then cd / && git -C "$TOP" worktree remove --force "$W" 2>/dev/null; fi ;;
+  *)
+    sed -n '2,24p' "$0"; exit 2 ;;
+esac
